apps.name: Hotline Navigator
apps.subtitle: Official Website
apps.localizedDescription:
Hotline Navigator:

Official Website.

What the hell is Hotline?:

Hotline in concept, was to replicate a BBS but for the internet age. Modern users would recongize more as a proto peer-to-peer or a Discord like application.

Hotline's Navigator's website has a deeper drive the history of Hotline.

Platform Support:

Right now the iOS, iPadOS, and Android versions are not in their respective app stores and must be built manually or sideloaded.

This is a Tauri-based Hotline client that provides a modern, cross-platform experience for the classic Hotline protocol. Built with React and Rust, it offers:

• Cross-Platform: Single codebase for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
• Modern Stack: React + TypeScript frontend, Rust backend.

• Native Performance: Tauri's lightweight architecture for fast, efficient apps.

versions.localizedDescription:
v0.2.8:

There's been a lot of rapid changes in Navigator's capabilities so this release UX quality-of-life series of fixes since the Discord style chat introduced a new UX paradigm which inevitable had some loose ends.

Disconnects are detected in seconds instead of minutes, chat icons no longer fall back to gray letter placeholders for emotes or for users who chatted before their info loaded, and! / / commands now appear above the bot's response instead of below it. News browsing also works on multi-tier servers like VesperNet, where top-level entries are folders of folders.

Next release will be new feature bound.

Bugfixes and Improvements:

• Faster disconnect detection — When a server vanishes silently (peer crash, network drop, NAT timeout), the client now notices in ~60s on macOS/Linux and ~130s on Windows, down from the OS TCP retransmit default of 15+ minutes. Auto-reconnect kicks in correspondingly faster.

• News browsing on nested servers — On servers like VesperNet where the top-level news entries are folders containing more folders, navigation no longer dead-ends with an empty article pane. The client now dispatches based on the clicked item's actual type (bundle vs. category) rather than assuming any non-root path holds articles.

Technical:

• TCP SO_KEEPALIVE configured on the control channel via socket2: idle=30s, interval=10s, retries=3 on macOS/Linux. Windows uses the OS default retry count.
• App-level keepalive failure now emits StatusChanged(Disconnected) and clears the transport, instead of silently breaking.

• Optimistic insert tagged with pending: true and optimisticKey; echo dedup matches by userName + message text within a 10s window. /me and /em are preformatted as *** name action to match the server echo. 30s safety timeout clears the pending flag if no echo arrives.
• News load effect dispatches on a tracked newsLeafType (2 = bundle → get_news_categories; 3 = category → get_news_articles). Going back always sets leaf type to bundle, since non-leaf path segments are bundles by invariant.

Installation:

Download the installer for your platform from the release assets.

.dmg = macOS, .msi/.exe = Windows, .apk = Android, .ipa = iOS/iPadOS, Linux hippies can figure it out.

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: An iPhone battery, charging and thermal instrument built on private iOS APIs — real charger watts, what actually reaches the cell, all 30 temperature sensors, and the USB-PD handshake
apps.localizedDescription:
MiniWatts:

English · 简体中文.

An iPhone and iPad battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs. It reads the device's own power-management sensors — the ones iOS uses to run the charge — and shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what every temperature sensor in the device is doing while it happens.

Sideload only. Private APIs mean this can never be on the App Store — you sign and install it yourself. There is no network code of any kind: nothing it reads leaves your phone.

Install:

Download the latest MiniWatts-unsigned.ipa from.

Apple ID — Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore and Xcode all do this. A free Apple ID works; the app then expires after seven days and you re-sign it.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

改进:

• 输入读数不完整时，不再当作输入功率显示。 在 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，输入传感器只测到了一部分功率（比如实际 43.5 W 只显示 21.8 W）。现在当进入电芯的功率比输入读数还大时，表盘改为显示"进入电池"的功率，不再计算效率和适配器利用率，并在功率页和适配器页说明原因。.
• 电池温度改用中位数。 部分机型有四个同名的电池温度传感器，其中一个明显偏高。"电池"读数、热力图上的电池标记和分区标题现在都用中位数，四个读数仍然逐个列出。.
• 异常温度不再参与计算。 以下读数不再计入热力图和最高温度，但仍保留在"原始数据"里，并注明原因：低于 −10 °C 的 PMU 传感器、高于 85 °C 而结温对不上的充电芯片温度、恰好为 0.0 °C 的传感器。.
• 支持 iPad。 支持横竖屏，内容不再横向拉满。iPad 的传感器对应关系还没有验证，数据仅供参考。.
• 文案更准确。 "来自充电器"改为"手机接口处 / 充电线圈处"；适配器页注明额定功率是协商出的上限，不是功率计读数。.
• 原始数据更便于反馈。 每个传感器带上服务编号，并列出被排除的读数。.

修复:

• 适配器：供电规格列表里不再出现"65.5 V × 65.53 A"这样的无效档位。.
• 实时活动：App 在前台时，读数变化 0.05 就会更新，不再等到变化 0.2 W 或 0.5 °C。.

注意:

• 这些修复是根据用户反馈的数据做的，没有在对应机型的真机上验证过。如果你的机型上读数仍然不对，请在 设置 → 原始数据 里复制导出并反馈。.
• iPhone 18 Pro Max 高功率充电时的完整输入功率仍然读不到，需要该机型在 45 W 状态下的原始数据导出。.
• App 退到后台后，灵动岛上的读数会停住，这是系统限制；想持续看实时读数请使用悬浮表。.

Improvements:

• An incomplete input reading is no longer shown as the input. On an iPad Pro and an iPhone 18 Pro Max the input sensors see only part of the power (21.8 W shown for a real 43.5 W, for one). When more power is reaching the cell than the input reading accounts for, the dial now shows the "into battery" figure, efficiency and adapter utilisation are not worked out, and the Power and Adapter pages say why.
• Battery temperature is a median. Some models have four battery temperature sensors under one name, one of them reading clearly high. The Battery readout, the heat map's battery pin and the zone header all use the median now; all four are still listed.
• Impossible temperatures are left out. These no longer reach the heat map or the hottest reading, and stay in Raw data with a reason: a PMU sensor below −10 °C, a charge-IC temperature above 85 °C that its junction sensor does not back up, and a sensor at exactly 0.0 °C.
• iPad support. All orientations, and content no longer stretches edge to edge. The sensor mapping on iPad is unverified, so treat its numbers with care.
• More accurate wording. "From charger" is now "At phone port" / "At charging coil", and the Adapter page says the rating is a negotiated ceiling, not a wall-meter reading.
• Raw data is easier to report from. Every sensor carries its service index, and excluded readings are listed.

Fixes:

• Adapter: the profile list no longer shows an invalid "65.5 V × 65.53 A" entry.
• Live Activity: with the app in front, it updates on a 0.05 change instead of waiting for 0.2 W or 0.5 °C.

Notes:

• These fixes were made from data users reported and were not verified on those devices. If readings still look wrong on your model, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
• On an iPhone 18 Pro Max the full input power at high-power charging still cannot be read; a Raw data dump taken at 45 W on that model is needed.
• Once the app is in the background the Dynamic Island reading stops. That is a system limit; use the floating meter for a live reading.

versions.localizedDescription:
Build 1.0.11. Install over the existing Sonic (2006) app and keep the bundle ID com.devz.sonic2006. The IPA is unsigned and contains no game files or patches.

Sonic '06 Mod Manager patches (.mlua):

The mod manager has a new Patches section for patches written for the Sonic '06 Mod Manager, such as Knuxfan24/Sonic-06-Mod-Manager-Patches.

• In the mod manager, tap Import folder and select the extracted folder.
• Tap the patches you want, then tap Play.

Patches run at launch on top of your mods. The installed game is never modified. Edited files go to mod-cache/patches and are reused until you change the selection.

What works: patches that edit archives, packages (.pkg) or files, and patches that change data in the executable. 39 of the 150 patches in Knuxfan24's collection run, for example Disable Fog, Disable Character Stumble, Disable Hint Rings, Disable Music, E3 Timers, Correct Sonic Jump Animation and Opposite Button Prompts. Another 17 already exist as built-in codes.

What doesn't (yet):

• Patches that rewrite game code (82 in that collection) can't run, because the game's code is recompiled ahead of time. Each shows the address it would change, and can be ported as a built-in code.
• Patches that edit Lua scripts as text (29 of them) need decompiled scripts. The game ships compiled ones.

Both kinds stay listed with the reason, instead of failing silently.

apps.name: Applesauce
apps.subtitle: A playful emulator for iOS. Plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on iOS 15+ — no jailbreak needed, though JIT is. An unaffiliated fork of touchHLE and HyperHLE; neither project endorses it
apps.localizedDescription:
Applesauce:

A playful emulator for iOS. It plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on modern iPhones — no jailbreak required, though JIT is. It installs and runs on iPadOS too, but every game runs as an iPhone guest for now: the core's iPad device families are not yet reachable from the app.

Applesauce is an unaffiliated fork. The emulation is entirely the work of touchHLE and its fork HyperHLE; this project is the iOS app built around them — the interface, the build system and the packaging. Neither project is connected to Applesauce or endorses it, so please report problems here rather than to them. No games or Apple software are included.

versions.localizedDescription:
Applesauce 0.4.1:

This update improves the library, game-session cleanup and AltStore Classic distribution. It keeps the same bundle identifier as 0.4.0, so it updates an existing Applesauce installation and retains its library and saves.

In AltStore Classic, open Sources → + and add:

Choose Applesauce from the source. Future releases appear in AltStore; you do not have to download a new IPA manually each time. Signing, refresh and JIT requirements still apply. The source does not enable JIT automatically.

Full installation and JIT guide.

Fixes:

• Importing copies files away from the main UI thread and coordinates access with Files providers such as iCloud Drive. A failed copy is cleaned up before it can appear as a partially imported game.
• Repeated taps cannot queue overlapping game launches. Library reloads are also suppressed while a game or import is active.
• Malformed game metadata that causes the HyperHLE parser to panic is caught at the native bridge. The library uses this parser regardless of the chosen gameplay core and falls back to a filename when metadata is unreadable.
• The FPS timer no longer retains the game-controls screen after exiting.
• The exit button respects the screen's safe area, and returning to the library uses the iOS 15 orientation fallback too.

• Building a second core copies only that core, avoiding accidental overwrite of a newer core with a stale file from another checkout.

• Migration instructions include saves and correctly explain which settings need to be reselected.

The AltStore source is checked against the unsigned IPA's version, build, minimum iOS, size, checksum and permissions. A release workflow updates the source for future published releases; prereleases and TrollStore packages are excluded from that automatic update.

Downloads:

• Applesauce-iOS-unsigned.ipa: AltStore Classic and other ordinary sideloaders.
• Applesauce-iOS-trollstore.ipa: the existing TrollStore route for supported older iOS devices, with JIT enabled through TrollStore.
• Applesauce-iOS-trollstore-permanent-jit.ipa: A11 and older only. Do not install this variant on A12 or newer devices.

The emulator versions remain HyperHLE v1.0.6 and touchHLE 0.2.3. This release does not claim additional game compatibility or fix the known Sims Medieval.

fresh device regression testing of 0.4.1 is still needed.

No games are included. Full credit for emulation belongs to touchHLE and HyperHLE. Applesauce is an independent, unofficial port.

Absorb:

A modern audiobookshelf client with a card-based player experience.

It's not "vibe coded" or auto-generated, every change is reviewed, tested, and shipped intentionally. That said, I'm all in on AI as a development tool. It massively speeds up the work and lets a solo developer ship features and fixes at a pace that wouldn't be possible otherwise. I'm sharing this openly so you know what's behind the app.

Features:

versions.localizedDescription:

• Made Test connection suggest a sign-in method without changing one you've chosen (@aaronbamblett).

• Filled translation gaps in German, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese and other languages (@aaronbamblett).
• Added app and server versions and the platform to logs copied with Copy debug log (@aaronbamblett).
• Reduced library and History loading times and cut repeated checks at launch (@yohanim).
• Stopped reloading the library when you leave a series without changing it (@yohanim).
• Reduced data use in Updates, library update progress and libraries with Continue reading button off (@yohanim).
• Explained why Tsumiru needs access to the local network in the iOS permission prompt (@Kisnov).
• Added connection and sign-in errors to the debug log (@yohanim).

• Removed sign-in tokens from cover and page addresses inside the mobile and desktop apps (@yohanim).
• Reduced the app's size by removing unused images and fonts (@yohanim).

🧩 Fixes:

• Fixed the offline banner disappearing while you were still viewing offline, keeping Go online available (@yohanim).
• Fixed the last page of a long strip hiding under the reader menu, with There's no next chapter on the final card (@aaronbamblett).
• Fixed long-strip chapters sometimes staying unread after reaching the end (@aaronbamblett).
• Fixed reader settings showing paged controls for series that open in long-strip mode (@aaronbamblett).
• Fixed migration sometimes failing to start on the web (@aaronbamblett).
• Fixed new-chapter notifications using the launcher icon on Android (@aaronbamblett).

• Fixed Back failing to close the app from Library after visiting History from More (@yohanim).

• Fixed unsupported device languages starting the app in Arabic instead of English (@Kisnov).
• Fixed the iOS and macOS app language lists to include Norwegian Bokmål, Brazilian Portuguese, Tamil and Traditional Chinese (@Kisnov).
• Fixed extra gaps above and below the reader when Ignore Safe Area is off (@Kisnov).
• Fixed restoring backups with uppercase file extensions (@Kisnov).
• Fixed source searches and filter changes mixing in results from the previous search (@yohanim).
• Fixed Browse and Updates failing to load more pages after switching between home and remote server addresses (@yohanim).
• Fixed Browse and Updates hiding loading errors or leaving the loading indicator spinning (@yohanim).
• Fixed setup skipping sign-in when a server behind a proxy requires Basic auth (@aaronbamblett).
• Fixed the reader losing your place or failing to load the next chapter after a connection change (@yohanim).

• Fixed some series showing zero unread chapters in the offline library (@yohanim).
• Fixed Browse freezing and crashing on Android 12 and newer with AVIF covers (@ArcoLuck).

• Fixed new chapters needing a manual library refresh after reopening the app with an expired sign-in (@yohanim).

• Fixed long-strip taps scrolling with animation when Animate page transitions is off (@aaronbamblett).

Mobile:

Android: download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

• SideStore signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
• AltStore expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
• TrollStore installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.

Desktop:

Windows: download …-windows-x64.zip, extract it anywhere, and run tsumiru.exe.

macOS: download …-macos-x64.zip, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Linux: the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

For a portable option, download …-linux-x86_64.AppImage, mark it executable with chmod +x, and run it.

Web:

Download …-web.zip and serve its contents with any static web server.

Full documentation.

apps.name: Veeb
apps.subtitle: Veeb is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator built specifically for iOS 26 and newer
apps.localizedDescription:
Veeb:

Vita is for Weebs.

!

Veeb is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator built specifically for iOS 26 and newer.

The project is focused on bringing Vita emulation to modern Apple devices while providing an iOS-native experience, including controller support, iCloud save synchronization, and JIT execution through StikDebug.

Veeb is highly experimental. Compatibility, performance, and stability may vary significantly between games and iOS versions.

Features:

• iOS 26+ support.
• Tested on iPhone 17 Pro.
• JIT support through StikDebug.
• iCloud synchronization for save data.
• Support for physical game controllers.
• iOS-focused interface and platform integrations.

• Based on the mature Vita3K emulator core.

JIT and StikDebug:

PlayStation Vita emulation requires significantly more processing power than a traditional interpreter can reasonably provide on mobile devices.

apps.name: MiruShin
apps.subtitle: Your anime, movies, and shows: discover, track, and watch in one beautiful app
apps.localizedDescription: Your anime, movies, and shows: discover, track, and watch in one beautiful app

versions.localizedDescription:
MiruShin continues to evolve as a modern and comfortable way to watch and discover media, with each update focused on making the experience smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable across the app.

What's New:

• Fixed incorrect episode-behind badges on finished anime.

• Handled broadcast statuses consistently across AniList, MyAnimeList and Shikimori without changing watch progress or library data.

v2.9.20:

• Airing metadata refreshes independently of watch progress and syncs between devices through Google Drive without generating upload echoes.
• Added Shikimori aired-episode counts and next-airing dates as a fallback when AniList scheduling data is unavailable.
• Added Russian and Japanese episode-backlog labels and regression tests for provider refreshes and cross-device schedule updates.

v2.9.19:

• Reduce Library-related UI stalls by reusing unchanged metadata and moving large native decoding and checksum work off the UI thread.
• Defer Google Drive sync while the player is open, keep progress saved locally, and automatically resume queued changes after leaving the player.
• Improve sync coordination during episode transitions and player shutdown, with safer deferred-sync status handling.

v2.9.18:

• Export your active Local Library from Settings to MyAnimeList XML or Shikimori JSON, including pending local edits, manga volumes, scores and dates where supported. Export works offline and reports entries without verified target IDs.
• Find Sources now starts with saved titles and enriches Russian, Japanese and English names independently, so AniList outages no longer block Russian searches. Provider matches are verified and cancelled searches stop their enrichment requests.
• Added optional MPV/FVP playback diagnostics with D-key micro-pause marking and manually saved, redacted reports. Diagnostics are at the end of Player Settings; no marker buttons or automatic report uploads.

v2.9.17:

• Choose AniList, MyAnimeList, or Shikimori as the only incoming library sync source; AniList is the default.
• Keep other connected catalogs as outgoing mirrors without allowing their edits or outages to overwrite the local library or switch the source.
• Safely retire obsolete destination conflicts and queued imports when changing the source, preserving local edits and audit history.
• Recover outgoing updates independently after restart and preserve unknown catalog-specific fields.

v2.9.16:

• Prevent unrelated catalog write echoes from downgrading Completed entries or clearing disputed dates and notes.
• Save conflict choices immediately and sync in the background without locking other entries.
• Fix duplicate sync delivery records and safely reconcile legacy account aliases and Google Drive confirmations.
• Report local database errors correctly without marking healthy catalogs unavailable.

v2.9.15:

• Reliable, independent library sync across AniList, MyAnimeList, Shikimori, and Google Drive, with immediate local saves.
• Automatic retries and catch-up after outages, reconnects, and app resume, without one unavailable catalog blocking others.
• Safer per-field reconciliation using genuine edit times, preserving precise scores, explicit clears, local-only fields, and change history.
• Clear per-anime conflict warnings and delivery details, including retry timing and sent-versus-confirmed status.
• Improved catalog pagination, write confirmation, and recovery of existing queued changes and verified duplicate records.

v2.9.14:

• Keep library progress and status unchanged when Auto Progress is disabled, while preserving playback resume positions.
• Restore shared episode progress from Google Drive and protect intentional resets from stale legacy checkpoints.
• Improve playback responsiveness with progressive proxy streaming and request-isolated retries.
• Reduce player UI rebuilds, repeated FVP metadata reads, and playback checkpoint overhead.
• Correct buffer range reporting and preserve existing seek, startup, and fallback behavior.

v2.9.13:

• Fixed a macOS shutdown bug where closing the window could leave MiruShin running or crash on Quit.
• Closing MiruShin now waits for the final playback checkpoint, background tasks, and all library databases before shutting down Flutter.
• Interrupted tracker deliveries remain queued and are checked before retrying on the next launch.

v2.9.12:

• Fixed cross-device status, score, and Favorite inconsistencies; Library cards and Edit now read the same canonical local state.
• Prevented stale provider previews, background queue writes, and rounded tracker scores from overwriting newer local changes.
• Isolated per-episode checkpoint revisions and deduplicated false sync conflicts while preserving genuine concurrent edits.
• Added safe, history-backed recovery for legacy library inconsistencies and 36 regression tests.
• Improved reactive local-library updates and avoided redundant no-op database writes.

v2.9.11:

• Restore fresh Google Drive Library changes before tracker sync on another device.
• Preserve Updated sorting and safely resolve cross-device conflicts.
• Keep delete/re-add operations ordered, and show clearer sync status.

v2.9.10:

• Local Library stays responsive while Google Drive restores data.
• Google Drive sync uploads small changes without rebuilding the full backup after every edit.
• Reduced backup processing on the UI thread and improved sync progress and counts.

v2.9.9:

• Fixed direct-media playback through the local proxy without requesting signed streams twice.
• Reuse a proven playback route for the next episode while keeping fallbacks.
• Redacted signed media URLs from player diagnostics.

v2.9.8:

• Fixed Google Drive Sync getting stuck after uploading local changes when a tracker API is unavailable.
• Improved sync progress, retry handling, and background storage-size refresh.
• Added details and a safe Ignore option for Library entries with unavailable metadata.

v2.9.7:

• Faster cross-device Library sync: recent Google Drive changes arrive before tracker reconciliation, without duplicate uploads from the receiving device.
• AniList, MAL and Shikimori now deliver rapid delete and re-add actions in order, with independent retries and safer confirmation after failures.
• Completing anime fills the known episode total and finish date together; unknown totals are requested explicitly.
• Reduced unnecessary Google Drive backups and improved sync progress reporting.

v2.9.6:

• Fixed Google Drive Library Sync convergence across new and existing devices.
• Devices now pull snapshots and immutable operations independently of the delivery lease.
• Added safe recovery for missed progress, additions, and removals without overwriting concurrent local edits.

• Improved sync progress counts and partial-sync messages in English, Russian, and Japanese.

v2.9.5:

• Fixed video freezing while audio continued by restoring MediaKit/mpv platform-tested frame-dropping and A/V-sync defaults.

v2.9.4:

• Restored native Google Drive sign-in on iPhone, iPad, and Android phones/tablets.
• Kept the secure Cloudflare Worker browser flow as a fallback for re-signed, LiveContainer, TrollStore, jailbreak, and Android TV installations.
• Added regression tests for platform-specific Google Drive login routing.

v2.9.3:

• Rebuilt Local Library as an offline-first source of truth with separate AniList account workspaces and safer AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori reconciliation.
• Expanded Google Drive Sync for complete library metadata, settings, addons, connections, playback state, and faster cross-device restoration.
• Fixed repeated Google Drive synchronization when nothing changed, improved pending and progress states, and made real local changes upload promptly.
• Added AniList outage fallbacks and cache-first Board, Discovery, Library, and details loading for faster navigation.
• Fixed immediate library add, edit, and remove behavior, per-page Library filters, account isolation, and local database placement.
• Fixed crashes when removing anime from the Library editor and when closing MiruShin on macOS.

v2.9.1:

• Improved Google Drive Library Sync with more reliable cross-device restore.
• Added complete library checkpoints with metadata and artwork for faster setup on new devices.
• Improved sync integrity with safer atomic restores and validation.
• Library data can now restore and display before connected trackers finish loading.
• Fixed MyAnimeList fallback handling for manga.
• Improved metadata synchronization and overall Library Sync stability.

v2.9.0:

• Added a canonical local-first Anime and Manga Library with safe offline mutations, Library Log, undo, conflict protection, and per-account workspaces.
• Added independent bidirectional sync for AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori with exact ID matching, provider snapshots, safer reconciliation, and richer metadata fallback.
• Added optional Google Drive Sync for libraries, playback progress, stream preferences, addons, accounts, API connections, Watch with Friends preferences, and per-workspace settings.
• Added all AniList score formats, including 100-point, decimal, 10-point, 5-star, and smiley scoring.
• Improved OAuth login flows across mobile, desktop, TV.

v2.8.9:

• Added instant local Library updates for add, edit, delete, progress, score, notes, and repeat actions.
• Added more reliable AniList, MAL, and Shikimori synchronization.
• Added offline change support with automatic synchronization after reconnecting.
• Fixed newly added anime not appearing until a manual refresh.
• Fixed completed anime remaining in Watching.
• Fixed incorrect episode progress, such as 13/12.
• Fixed changes being applied to the wrong anime after Library reordering.
• Removed unnecessary Library reloads and delayed UI updates.
• Improved favorite and score update consistency.

v2.8.8:

v2.8.7:

v2.8.6:

• Fixed player sessions not terminating correctly and restored proper playback speed handling.
• Fixed expired airing schedules still appearing in the Library.
• Improved seeking controls by separating arrow tap and hold behavior.

v2.8.5:

• Fixed streams freezing during startup and playback unexpectedly resuming after being paused.
• Fixed playback-speed changes causing stalls or showing a speed that was not actually applied.

• Added accumulated seek-distance feedback when repeatedly using the left and right arrow keys.
• Improved the Library AniList outage notice with scrolling, MyAnimeList fallback status, dismissal, and correct spacing.

v2.8.2:

• Improved add-on import, export, and backup reliability across devices.
• Fixed add-on restoration so exported configurations retain required module data and settings.

v2.8.1:

• Fixed MAL and Shikimori fallback responses overriding AniList library status and progress after an AniList outage.
• AniList now remains canonical when selected as the primary tracker, while fallback snapshots stay available without reopening completed titles.
• Local changes made during an outage remain queued and sync to AniList first, then independently to connected MyAnimeList and Shikimori accounts.
• Prevented automatic playback progress from reopening completed titles or dropping rewatching status.
• Entry edits now sync only fields that actually changed, so score or notes edits cannot overwrite status or progress.

v2.8.0:

• Added MyAnimeList fallback for AniList outages across Board, Discovery, media details, Library, and Watch Order, with automatic return to AniList after recovery.
• Added local-first tracking: progress, favorites, status, score, notes, repeat count, and dates are saved locally and safely synchronized later.
• AniList, MAL, and Shikimori now synchronize independently using stable media identity, offline mutation queues, provider health tracking, and conflict resolution.
• Library filters, sorting, Watch, Edit, Play, and continue-watching now work with locally cached and MAL fallback data during AniList outages.

v2.7.12:

apps.name: Flixor
apps.subtitle: Modern cross-platform Plex client
apps.localizedDescription:
About:

Flixor is a modern, cross-platform Plex client that brings a Netflix-like experience to your media library. Browse beautiful rows, see rich metadata with ratings from multiple sources, and enjoy powerful playback on any device.

Core Experience:

• Netflix-style UI - Continue Watching, Trending, Collections, Watchlist, and more.
• Rich metadata - Trailers, cast info, tech badges (4K/HDR/Atmos/DTS-X).
• Smart search - Search across Plex and TMDB with intelligent filtering.
• Ultra-fast grids - Optimized for libraries with thousands of items.
• Cross-platform sync - Watch progress syncs across all your devices.

Playback:

• Web: Built-in DASH/HLS player with Picture-in-Picture and subtitle support.
• macOS: MPV-powered with HDR, Dolby Vision, and advanced audio passthrough.
• Mobile: Native players with background playback and streaming quality options.

versions.localizedDescription:
This is a Major announcement. Had a super busy last month so release got delayed then what I had in my mind initially.

Official site is https://flixor.xyz, you can sign up to get updates via email there.

TvOS Alpha::

TestFlight link is ACTIVE this is the link: https://testflight.apple.com/join/hwRWYxBs

I am accepting few invite only signup for app testing (Limited to 100): you can sign up here: https://forms.gle/aHrSa9Kg54JvTYKB7

Keep an eye on the testflight when apple completes it review it will get active.

This first ALPHA release of TvOS you will see many UI and Performance bugs. Not all features from Mobile and MacOS are there in this TvOS release.

Please test everything, and report issue you are seeing in detail with screenshots preferably on Github issues.

Mobile and MacOS now has Stremio Addon support, you primary login of Plex is still required. The support is experimental please post and share how things are working on your end for this feature.

tvOS Alpha.

• The Apple TV app now has a real usable foundation with Home, Shows, Movies, My List, Search, New & Popular, and Settings.
• The details experience got a major parity pass with richer layouts, collapsible headers, logo art, better metadata grids, technical badges, and trailer support.
• Playback is now wired up with MPV support and in-player controls for quality, audio, and subtitles.
• We also spent a lot of time on the stuff that matters on tvOS: smoother focus behavior, better scrolling performance, GPU/rendering cleanup, cache crash fixes, and better image handling.
• Settings and service integrations are now connected for Plex, TMDB, MDBList, Overseerr, and Trakt sync/scrobbling.

It’s still alpha, but it’s finally at the point where real Apple TV testing makes sense instead of it feeling like a prototype.

Other work that landed in the same stretch.

• Stremio support is now in mobile and macOS, including addon management, source selection, resume handling, and subtitle provider support.

• Mobile customization also improved: you can hide the My List tab, toggle Plex genre rows, and the default details layout is more consistent.
• We fixed a bunch of mobile rough edges too, especially around non-English titles/backdrops, Trakt episode navigation, scrobbling, and Android performance.
• macOS picked up Stremio support, a Recently Added row, fresher Continue Watching updates, subtitle settings, HDR color improvements, and general UI/navigation cleanup.

For next three months no new features will be added. Work and updates will focus primarily on TvOS feature parity, fixing bugs and improving performance on all platforms.

versions.localizedDescription:
CyPort v1.2:

Run your own copy of Cyberpunk 2077 for Mac natively on iPhone and iPad – no emulation, no streaming.

Not affiliated with CD PROJEKT RED.

This release is about heat and frame times. On an iPhone the limit isn't raw speed, it's heat: the phone used to throttle within a minute or two of open-world play, and then the frame rate jumped around.

❄️ Cool mode (always on):

• The engine's 5 job worker threads ask for the highest thread priority, which kept them all on the A18 Pro's 2 performance cores next to the game and render threads – that is what made the phone hot so fast.
• CyPort now runs 3 of them on the 4 efficiency cores, which do the same work for far less power. 2 stay on the performance cores, so the game thread doesn't wait on slow cores every frame (all 5 on the efficiency cores felt stuttery).
• Tunable in macshim.plist: CoolFastWorkers (default 2), CoolMode = NO turns it off.

🏙️ Steadier frame rate in the open world:

• The engine streams the city in on the game thread, by default up to 12 ms and 300 objects per frame – desktop values. At 30 FPS a frame only has 33 ms, so on a phone that showed up as frame drops while driving.
• CyPort now writes engine/config/platform/mac/user.ini at every start with 6 ms / 200 objects per frame: the work is spread over more frames. Things may appear a moment later.
• StreamingTweaks = NO restores the engine defaults; StreamingMsPerFrame / StreamingNodesPerFrame set your own values. If you edit user.ini yourself, remove its first line and CyPort leaves it alone.

🧹 Fewer hitches from CyPort itself:

• The worker-thread profiler from v1.1 paused all job workers for 2 s every minute – a regular hitch. Now off by default (WorkerSampler = YES to turn on).
• The log no longer forces a disk flush after every line (that blocked game threads). Crash reports are still written in full.
• Periodic statistics lines are only logged with Diagnostics = YES.
• With the performance overlay set to Off, its window is now removed completely, so iOS no longer has to composite it over the game.

🛠️ Other:

• The start screen marks the resolutions that make the phone hot quickly.
• The log now shows how busy the GPU is (1 s sample every 30 s), to tell GPU heat from CPU heat. GPUSampler = NO turns it off.
• Optional frame pacing for testing: FrameRate = 30 / 40 / 60 in macshim.plist. By default the frame rate is the game's own setting (Settings → Graphics → VSync / Maximum FPS).
• CPUCount now also reports a matching number of performance cores.

Performance tips:

• Resolution 1434 × 660 on the start screen – at 1912 × 880 an iPhone 16 Pro Max still throttles within about 1.5 minutes of driving.
• Maximum FPS 30 in the game's graphics settings: a steady 30 looks smoother than a rate that jumps between 25 and 50, and the phone stays cool much longer.
• Leave frame generation off.
• A clip-on phone cooler helps more than any setting.

Upgrading:

Rebuild the IPA with this version (./build.sh, see the README), then reinstall. Your game data, saves and settings stay in place.

Known issues:

• The phone still throttles in long open-world sessions; expect ~20–30 FPS while driving once it's hot.
• The streaming change and the 2-fast/3-efficient worker split are new and have only had short tests – please report pop-in or stutter.
• The free Apple ID route (SideStore + GetMoreRam, compact memory layout) is still untested on a device.

apps.localizedDescription:
🟣 TwitchUnblock:

TwitchUnblock is an open-source Twitch client that lets you watch VODs and live streams without a subscription, at full quality. Native iOS app built with SwiftUI — also available in your browser.

🤖 Vibe-coded project. TwitchUnblock is built with AI coding assistants (prompted, reviewed and tested by a human). Expect rough edges: bug reports on Discord help a lot.

Install it and it works. There is nothing to configure, no server to set up, no key to paste. The backend is already hosted and shared by every install.

Watching:

• 🚫 No subscription required — watch any VOD or live stream at full quality.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automatic build of the master branch on 2026-10-15.

• Polls: the developer can ask a question under the home announcement; vote without an account, change your mind until it ends, and see the results once you've voted.
• Settings → Channel points tracks, like drops, the time you watched and the points you earned by watching: right now, in total and per channel.
• Predictions show, like the Twitch app, the points bet on each outcome, its return ratio, how many people bet and the biggest bet, plus what your bet would win.
• The Home live list refreshes on its own when you come back to the app and every 3 minutes while it's on screen.
• While a live loads, the player says which source it's trying and can be minimized or closed; the screen now only stays awake while a video plays on screen (paused, minimized or audio only, it sleeps).
• Apple's player (immersive player off) resumes VODs and clips where they were, even after a quality change, and its lock screen activity follows pause and progress; the sleep timer now also stops multi-live.
• Closing the player or starting another video during Picture in Picture now ends it cleanly, changing quality keeps your place, and a stream that drops shows a Retry button instead of freezing.
• When no source can play a live stream, or Twitch doesn't answer, the player now says so with a Retry button instead of calling the channel offline; lives also start when Twitch's own API is unreachable.
• Cloud sync keeps each Twitch account's history apart, and a VOD or channel you delete in the app is removed from the backup right away.
• A category you follow on Twitch now shows as followed on its page and can be unfollowed there; category lists get Retry and pull to refresh.
• Search opens clip links and starts VOD links at their?t= time; channel pages open faster, and the VOD filter can look through older VODs.
• Restoring an expired Twitch web session now asks you to sign in again, and drops stop counting for an account you signed out of.
• Playback resumes on its own after a call or another app's audio: VODs where they left off, live streams back at live.
• Opening the app no longer stops music playing in another app: the sound only switches over when a video starts, and goes back to that app when you close the player.
• Multi-live now mixes lives and VODs (up to 4 videos): add a VOD from the player's ⋯ menu, by long-pressing a VOD card or My VODs, or by pasting its link or ID in the mosaic.
• VOD tiles resume where you left off, with play/pause, ±10 s, a seek bar and “Watch again”; their progress is saved and synced.

• The multi-live “+” accepts a channel link or @name.

• Subscribed to a channel (or Turbo)? With the web session connected, its lives now play through your Twitch account, without ad breaks (Settings → Player → Watch ad-free with my sub).
• During a channel's ad break, the player now explains the purple “Commercial break in progress” screen, shows when the stream comes back and mutes the sound meanwhile.
• Live source descriptions no longer claim the proxies are ad-free: they still get the channel's ad breaks.

• Reopening a VOD in the same session no longer shows its restored muted parts in orange on the progress bar.
• Muted parts of recent VODs in the MP4 format keep their sound again when Twitch still serves it, instead of being swapped for the silent version.
• Emote cards also open from a message thread, with sharp FrankerFaceZ emotes and badges.
• Emote cards now show the scope and author of BetterTTV, FFZ and 7TV emotes, the 7TV original name, zero-width and modifier emotes, and a link to the emote's page.
• Twitch emote cards show the emote type (global, sub tier, channel points), the channel it belongs to (live or not, with See channel) and its other sub emotes of the same tier.

• Long-press an emote in the emote picker to open its card or copy its name; the picker is now translated.
• VoiceOver can open emote and badge cards.

• Unfollowing from the player or a channel page now asks for confirmation, with a shortcut to hide the player Follow button.
• Hype train: the bar shows the progress of the current level.
• Hide a channel or a category from Top and Categories with a long-press, and show it again from Settings → General.
• Apple TV: hide channels and categories too (press and hold a card).
• A channel's VODs load past the first 100 again.
• Without an account, categories, live channels in a category and a channel's clips now load past the first 100.
• Without an account, top streams on Home get a Load more button (30 at a time).
• Preferred quality in Settings → Player (Source, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p, 160p or audio only): lives, VODs and clips start in it, or in the closest one below when the channel doesn't have it.

• Qualities are sorted by height then frame rate, and "audio_only" now reads "Audio only".

• Apple TV: preferred quality in Account → Settings, with the same closest-below rule.
• Playback speed for VODs and clips (0.25× to 2×) in the ⋯ menu of the player; the VOD speed is remembered, shown next to the timer, and live streams always stay at normal speed.
• The lock screen and the Live Activity follow the playback speed of a VOD.
• Resuming from Picture-in-Picture now updates the play/pause button.
• Live streams no longer speed up to catch up with the live edge, which could pull the sound out of sync; the player now makes a small jump only when it really falls behind.

• When the developer replies to one of your reports (or changes its status), you get a notification, even with the app in the background; tap it to open My reports.

• BetterTTV: personal emotes of BTTV Pro users show up once BTTV announces them, and emotes added to the channel during the stream appear right away.
• Pin your favourite streamers: long-press a followed channel (live or offline) and pick "Pin to the top of Following". Pinned channels show first, with a small pin next to their name.

• Live notifications through ntfy: fixed on the server side (ntfy.sh was turning the server away), and the Test button now tells you when ntfy.sh is refusing messages for now instead of saying the server can't be reached.
• Other improvements and fixes.

apps.name: Modu
apps.subtitle: An open-source, cross-platform ebook and PDF reader
apps.localizedDescription:
功能一览 · 设置指南 · 文档目录 ·.

交流与反馈:

欢迎关注 Modu 默读频道，并加入 Telegram 讨论群或 QQ 交流群：.

封面左上角显示绿色「已索引」状态，左下角用不同颜色标注 EPUB、PDF、TXT、MD、FB2 等原始文件格式；识别为扫描版或手动设为扫描图片书籍时，还会显示「扫描版」标签。TXT、Markdown 等转换为 EPUB 后，仍保留原始导入格式标签。.

默读不提供内购解锁或订阅；在线服务商自行收取的费用不属于默读内购。.

下载:

最新版本：1.2.10 — PDF／OCR 重排统一电子书菜单与样式，改进分段并保留笔记原图位置；修复 Edge 朗读、夜间配色、备份与迁移，完善安全反馈日志，E-Ink 锁定纯白底黑字。.

应用每次启动检查更新，也可在「设置 → 关于默读 → 版本检查与更新」选择 GitHub 或 Gitee，检查、下载、取消并打开安装器。默认优先 GitHub，连接失败时自动尝试 Gitee；手动选择 Gitee 则直接使用镜像。两站提供相同安装包及 SHA-256，应用内下载安装前再次校验。macOS 使用浏览器下载 DMG。Gitee 保留最新版，GitHub 提供历史版本及完整源码。.

检查与下载共用一个来源选择，切换来源后重新检查即可。语言可在「设置 → 外观」手动选择或跟随系统，内置 AI 提示词随应用语言切换；用户自行编辑的提示词保持原文。.

这里的 x64 指 x86-64，ARM64 也是 64 位。iPhone/iPad 没有 x64 真机包。.

桌面端提供原生安装包，GitHub 的 Source code (zip) 用于获取源码。签名、依赖和安装步骤见 安装指南。.

功能一览:

从整理书库，到沉浸阅读、随手记录，再到用 AI 深入理解——把常用工具放在阅读身边。.

保留原版，也让扫描书更好读:

保留原书的图文版式，同时让书页适应眼前的屏幕。PDF 与已识别为扫描版的图片书使用专用阅读菜单，不再套用普通文字书的字体、行距控件。.

EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2 在导入时识别图片书，打开时不重复检测，也可通过书架菜单手动切换。普通文字书继续使用原有阅读菜单与样式。.

自动裁边可应用于全书，每一页分别识别边界。建议保留少量留白，保护页码、脚注和文字边缘。扫描水印减淡属于图像处理，不能保证还原被水印遮挡的文字，请对照原图确认。.

菜单颜色跟随软件主题；只有开启 E-INK 模式才显示专用刷新控件，硬件刷新效果取决于设备支持。普通文字书保持原有阅读菜单与样式，不受扫描版设置影响。.

让扫描书，也能划词阅读:

不止于放大一张图片。识别出的文字直接进入阅读界面，可以调节排版、划词、标注、记笔记，也可以继续使用 AI 阅读工具。.

• 在**「设置 → OCR 模型」选择模型和下载源，推荐先使用 PP-OCRv4 中英文版。没有网络的设备可使用卡片中的离线导入**，导入对应版本的完整模型文件。.
• 打开 PDF／扫描书菜单：文字重排利用已有文字层，OCR 重排识别页面图片。按当前整页或裁边后的区域重排，无需再次选择范围。.
• 在重排正文中选词，进行复制、翻译、标注或 AI 提问；齿轮入口调节识别文字的样式，不改变原图和其他书籍。.
• 只需要某段内容时，使用**「提取」**选择区域，将文字送入 AI 输入框草稿，检查、编辑后再发送。.

模型按需下载，不内置在安装包中。可选上游或 Gitee 镜像，也可离线导入；仅接受列表中对应型号的固定下载版本，完整文件组通过大小与 SHA-256 校验后才安装。模型卡片提供删除选项，释放空间时不删除书籍或已识别文字。.

下载后在本机离线识别，无需 API Key；将提取文字发送给在线 AI 是另一个独立操作。识别效果受清晰度、语言和版式影响，姓名、数字和复杂分栏应对照原图核验。OCR 不会自动向量化整本书，也不会改写原始 PDF。.

让每本书，都有位置:

支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、Markdown 和文字 UMD，可从本地或远程文件夹勾选导入。按阅读状态筛选，用文件夹整理书籍，把常读的书或文件夹置顶。.

versions.localizedDescription:
Modu 1.2.10:

Build / 构建：10129 · Stable / 正式版.

English:

• Fix(reflow): Remove narration from PDF/OCR reflow menus, selection actions and playback shortcuts; prevent speech from falling through to the hidden original page. Ordinary ebook narration remains available.
• Fix(ocr): Reduce excessive reflow paragraph breaks by measuring printed line spacing per column and requiring clear paragraph gaps, first-line indents or trailing whitespace. Join ordinary sentence wraps and nearby same-row OCR fragments; upgrade cached layouts without rerunning OCR while preserving historical note revisions and source coordinates.
• Fix(eink): Lock E-Ink to pure white backgrounds and pure black text across the app, ebook reader and OCR reflow, regardless of dark/night mode. Preserve saved reading palettes and background images when E-Ink is disabled.
• Fix(reflow): Reuse the actual ebook quick-style component for OCR/reflow font size, thickness, line/paragraph spacing, fonts, palettes and backgrounds. Keep typography book-local and additional reflow settings behind the gear button.
• Fix(reflow): Use the ordinary ebook menu host and button order for PDF/OCR reflow. Keep the original-page/mode header and PDF page arrows; both compact and menu arrows automatically reflow the adjacent source page and reuse cached recognition. Preserve PDF preprocessing budgets and caches.
• Feat(reflow): Infer paragraphs and first-line indents from source line geometry while retaining uncertain headers, footers and short lines. Reuse ebook color/background editors, imported fonts and spacing controls; add reflow-aware page navigation, search, copy, query/translation, AI drafts and bookmarks. Keep historical text-layout revisions intact for existing annotations.
• Fix(reader): Switch ordinary ebook night colors without repagination or waiting for fonts; apply reader colors to nested publisher text and headings when original-book styles are disabled. Keep OCR reflow and original-page toolbars mutually exclusive, with immediate opaque night colors on reflow text and no hidden source-page repaint.
• Feat(notes): Preserve original page numbers and uncropped image line/text-block coordinates with new PDF/OCR reflow notes. “View original” shows the saved source regions without rerunning OCR; re-recognition never rewrites existing notes or their text revisions. Older notes remain available without guessed image positions or forced text matching.
• Feat(feedback): Remove contact links from feedback; include independently optional crash and safe current-session runtime diagnostics by default in bug reports, with full preview before confirmation. Record content-free reader, narration, sync, lifecycle, timing and memory events; runtime history clears on every restart while crash diagnostics remain separate.
• Fix(backup): Resolve library and cache paths before starting the ZIP worker, avoiding uninitialized Windows preferences during database export.
• Fix(storage): Schedule Windows storage relocation before database startup, verify copied files and retain the original library; only switch paths after successful copying.
• Fix(android): Stage settings exports in app-owned cache before opening the system save dialog; distinguish file, system-service and settings-format failures instead of reporting all failures as permissions.

简体中文:

• Fix(reflow): 移除 PDF／OCR 重排的朗读菜单、划词朗读和播放快捷键入口，避免误读隐藏原页；普通电子书朗读保持不变。.
• Fix(ocr): 减少重排过度断段，按栏测算实际行距，仅在明确段距、首行缩进或段尾留白时分段；合并普通句内换行及同一行 OCR 碎片。旧缓存无需重新识别即可更新排版，历史笔记版本和原图坐标保持不变。.
• Fix(eink): E-Ink 强制锁定浅色，应用界面、电子书与 OCR 重排统一为纯白底纯黑字，不随深色／夜间模式切换；关闭后恢复保存的阅读配色和背景图。.
• Fix(reflow): OCR／重排样式面板直接复用普通电子书组件，统一字号、粗细、行距／段距、字体、配色与背景布局；排版仅保存到当前书籍，重排附加参数收进齿轮设置。.
• Fix(reflow): PDF／OCR 重排直接共用普通电子书菜单及按钮排列，保留顶部原页／重排模式和底部 PDF 页码箭头；底部与菜单翻页均自动重排相邻原页并复用识别缓存，保留 PDF 预处理提前量和缓存逻辑。.
• Feat(reflow): 根据原页行坐标恢复分段和首行缩进，保留无法确认的页眉、页脚及短行；复用电子书配色、背景图、导入字体与间距设置，补充适配重排文字的跳页、查找、复制、查询／翻译、AI 草稿及书签。保留历史文字排版版本，避免旧划线与笔记错位。.
• Fix(reader): 普通电子书切换夜间配色不再重新分页或等待字体；关闭原书样式时，内嵌文字与标题一并跟随阅读配色，避免夜间仍显示黑字。OCR 重排与原页工具栏互斥，避免两套菜单叠加，识别／重排文字立即切换不透明夜间配色，不再同时重绘隐藏原页。.
• Feat(notes): 新增 PDF／OCR 重排笔记保留原始页码及未裁切原图的行／文字块坐标；“查看原图”按保存时位置框选核对，不依赖重新 OCR。重新识别不改写既有笔记及文字版本；旧笔记保留，不猜测坐标、不强行匹配。.
• Feat(feedback): 问题与反馈页面移除联系方式；Bug 报告默认附带可分别取消的崩溃日志和安全运行日志，提交前预览完整内容并确认。补充不含私人内容的阅读、朗读、同步、生命周期、耗时与内存记录；运行记录每次重启清空，崩溃诊断独立保留。.
• Fix(backup): 在主线程确定书库和缓存路径，再启动 ZIP 压缩，修复 Windows 数据库导出时设置未初始化的问题。.
• Fix(storage): Windows 存储迁移改在重启后、数据库打开前执行，逐文件校验并保留原书库，复制成功后才切换路径。.
• Fix(android): 设置导出先写入应用缓存，再调用系统保存窗口；区分文件读写、系统服务和设置格式错误，不再统一提示权限问题。.

apps.name: BrewLog
apps.subtitle: A pour-over brewing companion for iPhone, with matching Android and web versions, in the spirit of Beanconqueror
apps.localizedDescription:
BrewLog:

A pour-over brewing companion for iPhone, with matching Android and web versions, in the spirit of Beanconqueror. It has a live BOOKOO scale connection, a guided brew assistant with soft audio cues, a brew journal, and rule-based (no AI) taste feedback that tells you what to change next time, down to the click on your grinder.

Features:

• Setup assistant on first launch: one simple question per screen with big tappable tiles: brewer → filter papers (the ones that fit your brewer come first) → grinder + your usual setting → beans → scale. Every step can be skipped. "Skip, just use the scale" goes straight to Quick weigh. Run it again any time from Gear → Setup assistant. If you skipped it, the Brew tab shows a small reminder card.

versions.localizedDescription:
feat(ios): BrewLog backup export/import and grind remembered per grinder.

• Settings → Backup & import: export everything as one JSON file in the format shared with web and Android ({app, format, exportedAt, data, samples, machine}, dates in ms, lowercase ids). Import merges by id and never replaces anything; it detects the wrapped format and the bare app data of Android exports. Non-UUID ids from the web app map to stable UUIDs. Everything is parsed leniently, sanitized and clamped (BrewLogBackup.swift).
• Switching grinders restores that grinder's own setting (set by hand after the last brew, else the history recommendation, else a starting value from the preset's defaultGrind or the typical range), like Android. No filter starting value for espresso.
• Tests for the format (Linux-runnable), SwiftData import/export round trip and grind memory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your Bluetooth coffee scale to read the weight live while you brew.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your espresso machine (GaggiMate) in your Wi-Fi to record pressure and temperature and to start shots.
