apps.localizedDescription:
🎯 What is this?:

A port of the open-source IW4L engine to iOS. It does not contain the game: it reads the game files you already own on PC. Think of it as a new player for files you have.

📊 Where it stands:

• ✅ Runs natively on iPhone (Rust + Bevy + Metal).
• ✅ Reaches the main menu. Touch works as a click and a PS4 controller works.
• ✅ On an iPhone 17 Pro Max (6 GB granted to the app) full matches with bots run: watch the clip, by treuenten.

versions.localizedDescription:
Bo1ZPocket 0.3.30:

Smoother on the phone, every touch button does its job, and co-op over Wi-Fi.

New in 0.3.30.

• New name: Bo1ZPocket. It's the same app: it installs over Pocket Lab and keeps your games folder and settings. In the Files app the folder now shows as Bo1ZPocket.
• Black Ops' own font for all the text. That covers the points, ammo and weapon name, the buy and door hints ("Hold USE to Open Door [Cost: 750]"), game over, the main menu, the options and the touch-button labels.

• It's read from your Black Ops install (its font sheet and font tables), so nothing is bundled.
• If the font can't be read, the old one is used.

Smoother zombies. Their movement looked rough for two reasons:

• Animation stepped. It only moved forward with each update from the game, 20 times a second, so walks and swings stepped. Now it moves forward every frame.
• Position overshot. The game guessed where each zombie was heading, so it overshot whenever one turned and then snapped back. Now each zombie is drawn between its last two known positions, one update behind, so its path is smooth.

The swings already ran at Black Ops' speed. They looked too fast because they stepped at 20 frames a second.

Blood when you shoot zombies:

• It sprayed sideways off the hit box. Now it sprays back toward you, as in Black Ops.
• Black Ops' blood effect has a near version and a far version (a big burst meant to be seen from across the map). Both played at every distance, so up close a big red haze showed beside the zombie. Now each plays only at its own distance, as in Black Ops. The same goes for every other effect with near and far versions (smoke, dust, light glows).

Checked on PC:

• the font on the HUD, hints, menu and options at the iPhone's screen size and pixel density;
• zombies drawn smoothly between updates (position and animation every frame);
• the blood's direction and the near/far split, in screenshots.

Not tried on an iPhone yet.

Not right yet: up close the blood is now a quick, small puff, and its colour is still lighter than Black Ops' dark red. Tell me how it feels.

New in 0.3.29.

• Zombies walk like Black Ops zombies. Black Ops moves a zombie by its walk animation itself, so its feet stay planted. Here every walker moved at one fixed speed, faster than any of its walks, so their feet slid along the floor. Now each zombie uses the walk Black Ops' script picks for it and moves at that walk's own pace, step by step. Kino's walkers go about half the old speed; some shamble even slower, as in Black Ops.
• No more instant hits. A zombie that got close damaged you that same instant. Now it swings like in Black Ops:.

• it uses one of Black Ops' attack animations (standing swipes, or walking and running ones that keep coming);
• the hit lands at the swipe's strike, and only if you're still within reach and in front of it;
• backing off makes it miss, and you have time to knife it first.

Points on a blood stain, bottom right as in Black Ops (top right with the touch buttons). It uses Black Ops' own score smear, coloured blood red.

Ambience. Kino's room tone now plays during a game. Black Ops starts it from client scripts this game doesn't run.

Touch buttons: layouts, icons, and moving them yourself. In OPTIONS → BUTTONS:

• Button layout:.

• CLASSIC, as before;
• LEFT FIRE adds a second fire button above the move stick;
• COMPACT pulls the buttons in and makes them smaller;
• SOUTHPAW mirrors everything, with the buttons on the left and the stick on the right;
• CUSTOM is your own.

• Button style: new icons (bullet, scope, reload arrow, hand, jump and crouch arrows, knife, grenade, swap) or the old text.
• Edit (in a game): drag any button where you want it, then DONE. RESET goes back to CLASSIC.

Size and opacity work with every layout.

The options are now on two pages, GAMEPLAY and BUTTONS.

Checked on PC:

• every layout and both styles at an iPhone's screen size;
• edit mode moving and saving a button;
• zombies' walk paces read from the animations;
• their swings landing on the strike;
• the blood-stain points;
• Kino's room tone starting;
• a 3-minute game with no zombie stuck.

Not tried on an iPhone yet.

Not done yet: when you knife a zombie slightly out of reach, Black Ops lunges you onto it. Here the lunge still only goes for other players.

New in 0.3.28.

• A main menu. The app now opens on a zombies menu in Black Ops' style instead of dropping you straight into Kino:.

• Kino's loading-screen art drifts behind a dark fade, under ZOMBIES and KINO DER TOTEN.
• SOLO loads the map; OPTIONS opens the options.
• With co-op set up the button says CO-OP. Joining someone else's room still goes straight in.

Options, from the menu or, in a game, from the new pause button at the top left:

• look sensitivity (5.0 as before);
• field of view;
• invert look;
• button size and opacity for the touch controls.

Use the – and + buttons, or tap or drag a bar. Your settings are saved. The game keeps running while the options are open; there is no pause yet.

Points and ammo. The points move to Black Ops' place, with a new ammo counter: weapon name, the clip large and the reserve beside it ("8 / 32"), the clip red when low. With the touch buttons on, they sit along the top right, clear of the buttons.

Touch controls:

• dark buttons that light up orange while pressed, and a red FIRE button;
• a faint ring where the move stick rests;
• the stick turns orange while you sprint;
• size and opacity follow the options.

Blood. Shooting a zombie now plays Black Ops' own blood effects, bigger for head shots and kills. Bullets used to make the dust and sparks a wall makes.

Zombies that rise out of the ground (Kino's theater, once the power is on) now climb out and come for you. They used to stand where they spawned. In a 3-minute test with the power on, 22 of 24 zombies got into play (before: 11 of 18). Two still got stuck at one theater window.

Starting ammo. Black Ops counts a weapon's starting ammo in reserve, on top of a full clip. The game counted the clip in it, so every Black Ops weapon started a clip short. The pistol now starts with 8 / 32, not 8 / 24.

New icon: glowing zombie eyes over a red chalk round tally.

Checked on PC:

• menu, options and the pause button at an iPhone's screen size;
• blood on hits;
• the risers;
• starting ammo;
• a 3-minute game in the foyer with no zombie stuck.

Not tried on an iPhone yet.

New in 0.3.27.

• Zombies move more like Black Ops zombies:.

• No more floating through windows and off ledges. Black Ops moves a zombie through a window, off a ledge or over a wall along the path built into that climb or jump animation. This game slid it in a straight line while a generic climb animation played, so zombies glided through window sills and floated down from ledges. Each window and drop now plays the animation Kino's map gives it (the window climb for the zombie's walk, run or sprint speed; jumps down 40, 72, 120 and 190), and the zombie follows that animation's own path up onto the sill and down to the floor. The game wasn't reading that path out of Black Ops' animation files at all; it does now.
• No more gliding over things to get unstuck. When a zombie couldn't move, the game slid it straight to where it was headed, through whatever was in the way. Testing found what was catching them:.

• landing from a window 1 or 2 units into the floor. They now land standing on it.
• Kino's closed stage curtain. Black Ops keeps zombies from routing through it until the power opens it. Zombies here took that route anyway and glided through the curtain.
• Before, a 3-minute test with every door open had 18 of those slides. Now: none with every door open and the power on, and none in 3 minutes in the foyer with the doors shut.

• No zigzag. Zombies walked to each point of Kino's path grid in turn and turned sharply at every one. They now head for the furthest point ahead they can walk straight to, and turn gradually. A shortcut that walks a zombie into a wall is never tried again.
• Smoother changes between animations. Going from walking to attacking or climbing blends over 0.2 seconds, as in Black Ops, instead of snapping to the new pose.

• The knife works: melee now hurts zombies (one stab kills a round 1 zombie, as in Black Ops).
• The crosshair turns red when it's on a zombie.
• Coming out of a sprint uses Black Ops' own timing for each weapon (0.3 seconds for the pistol). The game wasn't reading Black Ops' sprint timings at all.
• Checked on PC:.

• 3 minutes in the foyer with the doors shut: 38 zombies, none stuck, 32 window climbs, all with Black Ops' climb animations, none sliding;
• close-up screenshots of zombies climbing in through a foyer window;
• zombies jumping off the stage into the theater: they step to the edge, then drop along the jump's curve and land on the floor (before: a straight slide down through the air);
• knifing round 1 zombies kills them;
• the red crosshair on a zombie.

• Found while testing, not fixed yet: once the power is on, the zombies that climb up out of the ground in Kino's theater stay where they spawn. The Black Ops script that raises them fails here. That's next.

New in 0.3.26.

• First part of Black Ops' own HUD. The round counter is now Black Ops' dark red chalk tally, bottom left: one mark per round up to five, then a crossed five plus more marks up to round 10. The old red number at the top left is gone. Perks you buy show their Black Ops icon above the chalk.

• Why they were missing: Black Ops draws these from its scripts with images that live in its own archives. The HUD only knew how to find Multiplayer's (MW2's) images, and it stretched images to the height of text (the chalk carries a giant text size for later rounds).
• On iPhone the chalk and perk icons stay clear of the rounded corner and the Dynamic Island.
• Checked on PC: rounds 1, 4 and 6 show the right chalk; buying Jugger-Nog shows its icon and takes 2,500 points.

• Not yet Black Ops' own: the points (still the yellow number top right), the ammo counter, weapon name and the round number after round 10. Those come from Black Ops' menu files and fonts, which are next.

New in 0.3.25.

• Each character's own arms in first person. Black Ops gives each Kino character their own: Dempsey (player 1) the POW arms, Nikolai (player 2) the prisoner arms, Takeo (player 3) the NVA arms, Richtofen (player 4) the hazmat arms. Black Ops' weapons only carry stand-in hands (the grey ones you've had). The script's choice now reaches your phone, and every weapon is held in those arms. Checked on PC: Dempsey's arms on the pistol and the MP5K, including the MP5K's first-raise animation.
• Not done yet: Black Ops' own HUD (next).

New in 0.3.24.

• Zombies have eyes again, glowing orange like in Black Ops:.

• No more see-through heads. The eyeballs are in the zombie head models, but their shader needs a view matrix the renderer never supplied, so every eye was skipped and you saw through the sockets. It's supplied now.
• The glow. Black Ops lights each zombie's eyes when it spawns and turns them off when it dies or loses its head. The game ignored that, and the eye bone lives on the head, which is a separate model, so the effect also had nowhere to attach. Effects now find bones on attached models, and they follow the animated pose instead of a stiff default pose, so the glow stays on the eyes as the zombie moves.
• Checked on PC with close-up screenshots of zombies attacking: solid eyes, orange glow on them. A 3-minute zombie test is unchanged: none stuck.

New in 0.3.23.

• The starting pistol no longer shoots zombies' limbs off. Black Ops never takes a limb off with the M1911 and checks that by its weapon name, m1911_zm. This game reported every Black Ops weapon with a multiplayer _mp ending (m1911_zm_mp), so the check never matched. Weapons now go by their real names, which also fixes any other Black Ops script that compares weapon names. Checked on PC with a test player shooting zombies:.

• starting pistol, before: 29 hits, 6 limbs off; now: 24 hits, none;
• MP5K wall gun, now: 16 hits, 4 limbs off (as in Black Ops, where other guns still do).

New in 0.3.22.

• Zombie pathfinding, mostly for once doors are open:.

• Zombies follow their spawner's instructions. Each place zombies spawn tells Black Ops how they should come in, and none of it ever reached the zombie:.

• Half of Kino's 50 spawn points (back rooms, balconies, stage) send their zombies straight at you instead of to a window. Those zombies went looking for a window anyway. Where their room has no way to one, they stood still until Black Ops removed them about a minute later.
• The two spawn points by the lobby name the window their zombies use. Their zombies instead picked one of the 3 nearest windows at random, so upstairs zombies sometimes went for a downstairs window. Following that instruction needed a path-point lookup the game didn't have.

• Zombies no longer fall through the back stairwell. Its steps are a ramp that only stops players and AI, and the game only applied the player part, so zombies dropped into the room below, where there are no paths. They now climb the stairs to their window.
• Zombies no longer bounce at the top of the east stairs. On their way to the theater, some zombies headed straight for a point at the foot of the stairs, hit the rail, and went back and forth.

• Checked on PC, 3 minutes per test, player unkillable so zombies keep coming:.

• every door forced open, player at the start: 29 of 30 zombies got inside and none got stuck (the last had spawned 14 seconds before the end). In 0.3.21: 23 of 36.
• every door forced open, player in the theater: none stuck; 6 of 7 crossed the map to the player.
• doors closed, player at the start and at the foot of the lobby stairs: no zombie stuck, same as 0.3.21.

• Not checked yet: the theater's own spawn points, including two where zombies climb out of the ground. In my tests the theater never switched on as an area, because the player was moved there rather than walking in. They now get their instructions like the others, but I haven't seen them spawn.

New in 0.3.21.

• The low walls under Kino's boarded windows show again. They're the splintered wooden panels zombies climb over. Black Ops keeps those two models in the map's language file (en_zombie_theater), and the map itself only refers to them by name. The game never looked there for models, so all 12 were missing and left a gap down to the floor. They now load from that file, are solid like the rest of the map, and zombies still climb in over them. Checked on PC:.

• the lobby window shows its wall where it showed a black gap before;
• two 3-minute tests (player at the start, then right next to that window): no zombie got stuck, and as many came in through that window as before.

• Not fixed yet: perk bottles and the teddy bear in the mystery box are missing the same way. They aren't in the language file, and where they are is next. Zombies that lose their legs don't crawl.

New in 0.3.20.

• Zombies no longer T-pose when they lose a limb. Since 0.3.19, Black Ops' limb-loss script runs to the end (before, it stopped early). It swaps the zombie's body for a damaged one, and this game treated the swap as a brand-new model with no animation. The animation now carries on through the swap. Checked on PC: zombies that lost an arm keep walking and reaching.
• Not fixed yet: zombies that lose their legs should switch to crawling and don't.

New in 0.3.19.

• Fewer of Black Ops' scripts stop partway through. Each of these used to stop the script that ran into it:.

• Sounds that tell the script when they've finished (voice lines waiting their turn) played, then stopped their script. They now report back about 2 seconds later.
• Asking whether a player has a weapon this game has no definition for (the zombie-kill voice lines ask about the sickle) stopped the script instead of answering no.
• Comparing two lists, and a dozen engine calls this game has nothing to show for yet: the teleporter's "transported" screen, rope collision, a wall gun's hidden parts, head gibs, vision sets, saving, and similar.

• Checked on PC: those script errors no longer appear in a match. Each effect isn't checked on screen one by one; the teleporter in particular still needs a play-through.

New in 0.3.18.

• Power-ups drop. When a zombie dies, Black Ops' script finds the floor under it with a ground check this game didn't have yet. The script stopped there every time, so nothing ever dropped. Checked on PC: an Insta-Kill skull, a Max Ammo and a Double Points dropped inside the lobby, each looked like the real thing, and walking onto the Double Points picked it up and doubled the points.

New in 0.3.17.

• Zombies no longer get stranded outside windows before they come in:.

• A zombie within a few steps of its spot at a window walked straight at it, even with a wall in between. At one lobby window that spot is round the corner of the frame, so it pressed into the wall for good. Now it only walks straight when nothing is in the way.
• A zombie upstairs, right above a ground-floor window, counted as having arrived at it. It then tried to tear boards 240 units below it. Arriving now needs it on the same floor. Black Ops then sees the window is out of reach and sends it to another. Checked on PC with two 3-minute tests (player at the start and at the foot of the lobby stairs): no zombie was stuck anywhere, against 10 in 0.3.15.

New in 0.3.16.

• Zombies coming down the lobby stairs no longer get stuck halfway, walking up and down on the spot. Halfway down, the nearest path point is a dead end that only leads back up to the landing. Each time a zombie re-planned (once a second) it started from that point, so it turned back up, then down again on the next plan. A zombie that is inside now starts its route from whichever point makes the whole way shortest. Checked on PC, 3 minutes with the player at the foot of those stairs: zombies stuck for 30 seconds or more went from 10 (6 on the stairs) to 2, and none on the stairs. Those 2 were outside one lobby window that zombies sometimes can't get through; that was already happening before and is next.

New in 0.3.15.

• Zombies no longer plan their way through closed doors. Black Ops marks every closed door and debris pile as blocking the paths through it, and unblocks them when you buy it; the game ignored both, so zombies walked into closed doors and kept pressing against them. Checked on PC: the door pieces block between 2 and 27 path links each at the start of a match.
• Zombies use the map's own jump-down and climb-up spots (54 in Kino), going up then across or across then down instead of walking into the ledge.
• A zombie stuck against a rail or ledge it could hop over no longer gets refused because of walls that only block players.
• Not yet seen on screen: a zombie using a jump or climb spot (none needed one in a 2-minute test standing at the start).

New in 0.3.14.

• Doors, debris and the boards on the windows now show. They are pieces of level geometry Black Ops' scripts move and hide, and none had ever been drawn, for three reasons:.

• the game never read them from the map file;
• the marker saying "this object is one of those pieces" was dropped on its way from the game to the renderer;
• the GPU code placed every piece of level geometry where the map was built, ignoring where the scripts had moved it. Checked on PC: the foyer door, the doorway under the lobby arch and a boarded window all show. Each piece is drawn where the game currently has it and not at all once hidden, so boards a zombie tears off should disappear and a bought door should swing open. That part isn't checked on screen yet.

• Co-op: every player needs 0.3.14; it can't join a game run by an older version.

New in 0.3.13.

• Likely fix for the shaking, flashing and doubled HUD. 0.3.12's self-test separated the batches of GPU work that really fail from the ones that only failed alongside them. The failing ones carry nothing but GPU timestamps. A built-in timing tool was writing timestamps into the GPU's work around every rendering step, every frame, and the iPhone rejects that work with "Insufficient Memory". Each rejection also took the rest of that frame's work with it, which showed as old, black or doubled frames. The timing tool no longer uses GPU timestamps on iPhone.
• If GPU work still fails 8 seconds into a match, the self-test from 0.3.12 runs again and keeps the best setting. Otherwise it doesn't run.

New in 0.3.12.

• A self-test for the shaking. 0.3.11's log shows about 11 of the roughly 41 batches of GPU work the game sends each frame failing with "Insufficient Memory", even batches with nothing in them. So the problem is in how the work is handed to the GPU, not in what is drawn. Starting 8 seconds into a match, the game tries five changes to that hand-off for 10 seconds each (no pacing; not sending empty batches; sending each batch on its own; one frame on the GPU at a time; all of them together), logs how many batches fail under each, then keeps the best one. The picture may stutter or slow down during that minute.

New in 0.3.11.

• Still no fix for the shaking. 0.3.10's log ruled out graphics memory: the graphics chip held 102 MB of its 5.4 GB limit when the "Insufficient Memory" failures began. So one batch of GPU work is going over some per-batch limit. The log now describes each failed batch (its drawing passes and screen size, number of draws and triangles, texture uploads, bound resources, how many batches were queued) next to batches that worked.

New in 0.3.10.

• No fix yet for the shaking and black/pink frames. This build finds their cause. In 0.3.9's log, the iPhone's graphics chip rejects almost every frame with "Insufficient Memory", starting on the loading screen while the game used under 1 GB of the 3.3 GB iOS allows. The log now records how much memory the graphics chip itself holds, Metal's limit for it, and every graphics allocation of 16 MB or more by name and size.

New in 0.3.9.

• The log names which part of a frame the GPU rejects, with Metal's own error text.

New in 0.3.8.

• About 1.2 GB less memory, measured rather than guessed: each of the game's ~2,000 shader programs kept a 600 KB parsed copy of its source alive (23x the source) after the GPU no longer needed it. The graphics library held it for the life of every pipeline; on iPhone it now lets go once the pipeline is built.
• The log now counts GPU frames that failed, and why (out of memory, timeout and so on). A failed frame is what shows an older frame again, or black: the shaking you see.

New in 0.3.7.

• Fixes the old frames showing up, stacked stick knobs, and doubled text (most likely also the "shaky" look). The 3D view now always replaces the whole screen each frame. Before, on the phone it could be blended over the screen instead, so older frames and the HUD from several frames back showed through.
• The log now lists which cameras draw the screen, and notes any frame where the 3D view failed to copy to the screen, with the reason.
• Still to do: memory. The game still uses about 3 GB on an iPhone 16e. It hasn't crashed in any of the logs, but it's close to the limit.

New in 0.3.6.

• Another big memory cut: the game kept the full source of every compiled shader (around 1.2 GB on the iPhone) after it no longer needed it.
• No more doubled HUD (two hint texts, two stick knobs on top of each other) or pink frames: on a frame where the 3D view wasn't drawn, the buttons and text were drawn over an older frame or leftover memory. That frame is now black, and the log counts how often it happens.

New in 0.3.5.

• Much less memory, and the end of the black and pink flashes mid-game they most likely caused. Your 0.3.3 session ran within about 0.1 GB of the iPhone's limit. Two things were eating it:.

• With sound on, the game retried building a menu sound bank that Black Ops doesn't have about every 2 seconds, re-indexing all 29,000 sound files each time. Now it tries once.
• Kino loaded a bot path map it doesn't use (zombies follow Black Ops' own paths). That cost up to 2.5 minutes of loading and about 1.4 GB. It's skipped now.

• Loading Kino should be much faster.

New in 0.3.4.

• No pink flash before the loading screen: the screen behind the game is now black while the game starts.

New in 0.3.3.

• Smoother: the game now runs at a locked 30 frames per second with its clock in step with the screen. Before, some frames moved the game ~1 ms and others ~65 ms, which made the view shake while you moved and looked around.

• SWAP no longer pulls out your grenade as if it were a gun.
• NADE throws a grenade. You start with none, as in Black Ops, and get 2 to 4 at the end of each round (that top-up never happened before).
• KNIFE plays the knife slash.

• Prompts: "Hold USE to ." now shows for the thing you're facing (wall guns) or standing at (doors, debris). The "You must turn on the power first!" prompt no longer sits on screen at the start.
• Co-op over Wi-Fi (see below):.

• When you go down, you're downed, not dead. A teammate stands over you and holds USE for about 3 seconds to revive you. Zombies leave downed players alone. If nobody revives you, you bleed out after about 45 seconds, watch as a spectator, and come back at the start of the next round.
• A player who joins lands on their own start point and can move. Before, Black Ops' own rule killed both players for standing in the same spot.
• A host that stalls for a moment no longer drops the other player.

• Jugger-Nog now actually raises your health.

Co-op (up to 4 players on the same Wi-Fi).

• It makes a file called Pocket Lab Co-op.iw4l-server in a co-op folder next to it. Copy that file to every phone that will play: Apple Devices → Files → Pocket Lab, next to the Games folder (or AirDrop it and save it to On My iPhone → Pocket Lab).
• Open Pocket Lab on the first phone. The first time, iPhone asks to let it find devices on your local network: allow it, then close Pocket Lab and open it again (that first try plays solo). With no game running yet, it hosts one.
• Open Pocket Lab on the next phone (same "allow, then reopen" the first time). It finds that game and joins it.
• To play from the PC instead of a second phone: run scripts\play-kino-on-pc.cmd from the source folder, with the co-op file next to target\play\iw4l.exe.

Without the file, Pocket Lab plays solo as before. If the PC server isn't running, it waits about 4 seconds, then plays solo.

What works.

• Zombies spawn from Black Ops' own round scripts, rip the boards off the windows, climb in and chase you over the map's own AI paths, with their walk, attack and death animations.
• Shooting them pays like Black Ops: 10 points a hit, 60 for the kill. Clearing a round starts the next one.
• Wall guns, doors and debris, the power switch, perks and the mystery box can all be bought.
• Going down solo ends the game: "GAME OVER - You Survived N Rounds", then the map starts over by itself after about 10 seconds.

Known problems.

• Zombies sometimes get stuck on a ledge or behind a door that is still closed.
• The mystery box does not show the weapons spinning before it gives you one.
• Co-op has been tested with two copies of the game on one PC (joining, playing, going down and being revived), not yet on two phones.
• The "revived" voice line doesn't play.

Setup.

• Install Pocket.Lab.ipa over the existing Pocket Lab (do not delete the app: that deletes the game files).
• First time only: copy the staged Call of Duty Black Ops folder (scripts/stage-bo1-for-iphone.ps1) into Pocket Lab's folder (Apple Devices → Files → Pocket Lab).
• Open Pocket Lab and stay in the app until the map shows.

Problem reports: iw4l-boot.log from the app's folder.

apps.subtitle: Unofficial Super Smash Flash 2 iPhone and iPad port with offline Ruffle runtime, customizable touch controls and gamepad support
apps.localizedDescription:
Super Smash Flash 2 for iOS:

An unofficial iPhone and iPad port of Super Smash Flash 2 v1.3.1.2 (Portable), running its original Flash game through Ruffle inside a native iOS app. The game and runtime are bundled for offline play, with a matching touch control deck, controller support, and a customizable layout.

If you want to support me and remain up-to-date about this and other projects, you can in different ways:

Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/dev_zer0

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@develop_erZ

Features:

• A touch control deck styled around SSF2: an eight-direction D-pad, jump, attack, special, shield, grab, taunt, pause, and Start / OK.
• Simultaneous touch inputs, diagonal movement, touch feedback, and adjustable control size and opacity.
• Customizable touch layouts: move, resize, and hide controls, with separate layouts for portrait and landscape.

versions.localizedDescription:
Adds the missing game-input bindings and dedicated C-stick controls.

• KEYS and controller action menus now include C-Up, C-Left, C-Down, C-Right, Jump 2, Shield 2 and Dash. Key bindings may also be left unassigned.
• The right stick defaults to the four C actions, using T / F / G / H for up / left / down / right. A diagonal tilt selects one C direction. Old unassigned right-stick defaults migrate once; existing custom action and key mappings remain.
• Adds an adjustable stick dead zone with threshold hysteresis and optional left-stick-strength walk/dash control. Light tilt sends movement; above 75% horizontal tilt adds Dash. This provides two speed levels rather than continuous analog movement.

Set up C-stick attacks:

In the game's Options → Controls → P1, bind C-Up = T, C-Left = F, C-Down = G, C-Right = H. These slots initially show n/a and must be assigned in the game too. Select each slot and tilt the corresponding right-stick direction to assign it. If your port controller settings previously used Attack on the right stick, change those mappings to the corresponding C actions in CONTROLS → CONTROLLER.

For optional walk/dash, bind the game's Dash to Shift, disable Auto-Dash and D-Tap Dash, then enable Left-stick strength controls walk / dash in the port. To assign an n/a slot on iPhone, map a controller button to that action, select the slot in the game, and press that button.

The portable Flash movie disables its desktop controller initialization. The iOS port still uses a GameController-to-keyboard bridge, so the in-game device list remains Keyboard. Native XInput and continuous analog movement are not enabled by this update.

Download SuperSmashFlash2-1.1.9-unsigned.ipa, sign it and install it. Keep the same signing identity and bundle identifier (com.devz.supersmashflash2) to retain your data.

apps.localizedDescription:
Unbill:

Unbill keeps shared expense ledgers on member devices and syncs them peer-to-peer. There is no hosted source of truth, hosted account system, or telemetry surface. The app records who paid and who owes whom. It does not move money.

Unbill is meant for households, trips, couples, and other small groups that already trust each other. It is not a payment network, bank integration layer, general accounting package, or product for hostile or anonymous groups.

Why Unbill:

• Your data stays on your devices. Ledgers sync directly between group members — no cloud account required.
• Works offline. Record expenses without a network. Changes merge automatically when devices reconnect.

apps.name: NFS Most Wanted
apps.subtitle: A static recompilation port of Need for Speed Most Wanted (Xbox 360 version) for iOS with various tweaks and QoL fixes
apps.localizedDescription:
NFSMW Recompiled for iOS:

Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005), Xbox 360, running natively on iPhone and iPad.

This is not an emulator. The game's PowerPC code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled for Apple's arm64 chips with the ReXGlue SDK. The SDK supplies everything around the game's code: the Xbox 360 kernel calls, the file system, audio, input, and a translation of the console's Xenos GPU to Vulkan, which runs on Metal through MoltenVK.

You need your own copy of the game. The app on the.

files: no textures, models, sounds, music, videos or tracks. It reads all of them from your own ISO of the USA Xbox 360 game. This repository contains no game files and no translated game code. See Legal.

versions.localizedDescription:
0.3.0:

• Fixes for freezes. The freeze after leaving the safehouse (and in some tollbooth races): the picture stopped while music and controls went on. And a rare black-screen hang at boot.
• iOS 26 works with the native renderer. It froze on the last movie frame or showed a black screen with only sound and controls: the game's shaders were built for iOS 27 only.
• Invisible cars in career with Black Edition on. Black Edition needs more car records than the game's table holds, and the extra ones were not saved with the career. They are now kept beside the save (from this version on: careers already affected keep their invisible cars).
• HDMI and AirPlay. An external display shows the game by itself, full size, while the phone keeps the touch controls.
• MetalFX (native renderer): temporal upscaling with the game's motion, to the screen, lighter, or anti-aliasing only. FXAA, MSAA where the game draws without it, and the game's own mip levels.
• Battery and heat. Battery mode (lower resolution, half-size shadows, car reflections updated less often), 30 fps in menus and pause, 30 fps when warm or on Low Power, 0.75x when hot, each also on its own. Less CPU spent waiting, no idle 120 Hz screen refresh, steadier frame pacing.
• Touch controls switch by themselves between the Pad layout in menus and the Drive layout while driving (with a small D-pad for free roam).
• 11" iPads: 4:3 fills the screen. "Stretch to full screen" is gone.
• Extra Options: Quick Race laps, opponents, traffic and weather.
• Save manager: saves, backups, export and import, iCloud Drive sync, cash and bounty per save.

Known issues:

• Skipping a movie can turn its last frame red for a moment.
• Launching the game for the first time may have stutters as it is caching all shaders in the background.

apps.name: Lyra
apps.subtitle: English · 中文
apps.localizedDescription:
A standalone agent with its own model settings. The desktop app is Electron, the phone app is React Native, and the phone works on the same sessions as the computer.

This is not a shell around Claude Code or Codex. The agent loop, tools, skills, and MCP are implemented here. You bring the models, plugins, and skills.

Download:

If you are not sure which architecture you have: on macOS look at the chip line in About This Mac, on Windows look at System type under Settings → System → About, on Linux run uname -m (x86_64 is x64, aarch64 is arm64).

AppImage or deb, not both. AppImage needs no installer: chmod +x and run it on any distribution. The .deb is for Debian and Ubuntu: sudo apt install ./Lyra--amd64.deb.

versions.localizedDescription:
New:

• The phone app has a layout of its own. It used to be the desktop window shrunk to fit: a row of small buttons along the top that sat under the clock and the battery, a rounded border drawn around the whole screen, the message box inside a second card, and menus hanging beside 44 pt buttons. Now:.

• Every menu rises from the bottom edge and goes back down when you pull it or tap the dimmed page. Long-press menus still open beside the row or the message you are holding.
• The message box has three controls: attach, the model, send. Reasoning effort is a row of choices in the model's sheet, with Permission mode and Image and video models under it. The model's chip draws the effort as bars, and shows a red dot while Full access is on.

• Settings is a list under a large title. Each page opens over it with ‹ Settings, and switches sit beside their names rather than under their descriptions.
• A new conversation shows its four starting points as two rows of cards, not a sideways row cut off at the edge of the screen.
• What a phone cannot use is gone from it: the question marks along the left edge, Open in new window, full screen, and the button that took a screenshot of the desktop.

Improvements & Fixes:

• On an iPhone in any language but English, the pairing screens were in English — and the pairing page's title was in Chinese whatever the language. The app now tells iOS which seven languages it speaks, so the pairing screens, the photo picker behind + and the copy-and-paste menu follow the phone. The camera prompt now says what the camera is for — the pairing code, or a photo to send — in the phone's language; it used to be one Chinese sentence about the QR code.
• On iPhone, a long-press menu closed the moment you lifted your finger. iOS sends a mouse click about 130 ms after a long touch ends, and the click landed outside the menu. The menu stays open now, and Copy copies.

• A sheet with a search box no longer opens the keyboard by itself. It covered most of the list it was there to search.
• Manage providers and models is no longer offered on the phone. Providers are set up on the computer, and on the phone the link opened General. With no models at all, the model sheet now says where to add them.
• Settings → Personalization has a title at the top, like every other page.
• GPT reasoning levels follow OpenAI's API. GPT-6.1 Sol had no levels of its own and fell back to Off/Low/Medium/High. Off sent effort: none, which it rejects, and after the 400 Lyra stopped sending a reasoning setting at all — so it ran at the default Medium, the opposite of Off. It now goes up to Extra high and Max, and on models that cannot turn reasoning off, Off becomes their lowest level. A few older entries were wrong as well: minimal on GPT-5.6, and Codex's ultra alias sent as-is. A level a model does not have now moves to the nearest one it does, instead of back to Medium.

개선 및 수정:

• 영어가 아닌 언어로 쓰는 iPhone에서 페어링 화면이 영어로 나왔습니다. 게다가 페어링 화면의 제목은 언어와 상관없이 중국어였습니다. 이제 앱이 지원하는 일곱 개 언어를 iOS에 알리므로, 페어링 화면, + 에서 여는 사진 선택 메뉴, 글자를 길게 눌렀을 때의 복사·붙여넣기 메뉴가 휴대폰 언어를 따릅니다. 카메라 권한을 묻는 문구도 카메라를 어디에 쓰는지(페어링 코드 스캔, 대화에 보낼 사진 촬영)를 휴대폰 언어로 설명합니다. 예전에는 QR 코드 이야기만 하는 중국어 한 문장이었습니다.
• iPhone에서 길게 눌러 연 메뉴가 손가락을 떼는 순간 닫혔습니다. iOS가 길게 누르기가 끝나고 약 130ms 뒤에 마우스 클릭을 한 번 더 보내는데, 그 클릭이 메뉴 바깥에 떨어졌기 때문입니다. 이제 메뉴가 열린 채로 있고, 「복사」도 제대로 복사됩니다.
• iPhone에서 시트나 대화 목록을 열면 시계와 배터리 표시가 검게 바뀌어, 어두워진 페이지 위에서 거의 보이지 않았습니다. iOS는 아래에 있는 색을 보고 글자 색을 정하는데, 반투명한 어두운 층을 밝은 배경으로 판단했습니다. 이제 계속 잘 보입니다.
• 검색창이 있는 시트에서 키보드가 저절로 올라오지 않습니다. 찾으려던 목록의 대부분을 키보드가 가렸습니다.
• 휴대폰에서는 「제공자와 모델 관리」가 보이지 않습니다. 제공자는 컴퓨터에서 설정하고 휴대폰에는 그 페이지가 없어서, 누르면 「일반」이 열렸습니다. 모델이 하나도 없을 때는 어디서 추가하는지 모델 시트에 알려 줍니다.
• 설정 → 개인 설정 맨 위에 제목이 생겼습니다. 다른 페이지와 같습니다.
• GPT의 추론 강도가 OpenAI API를 따릅니다. GPT-6.1 Sol은 자체 단계가 없어 기본값인 「끔/낮음/보통/높음」을 썼습니다. 「끔」은 effort: none을 보내는데 이 모델은 이를 받지 않았고, 400이 돌아온 뒤 Lyra가 추론 설정 자체를 보내지 않아 결국 기본값인 「보통」으로 생각했습니다. 「끔」과 정반대입니다. 이제 「매우 높음」과 「최대」까지 고를 수 있고, 추론을 끌 수 없는 모델에서는 「끔」이 그 모델의 가장 낮은 단계가 됩니다. 예전 표의 오류(GPT-5.6의 minimal, Codex 화면의 별칭 ultra를 그대로 보내던 것)도 고쳤습니다. 모델에 없는 단계는 「보통」으로 돌아가지 않고 가장 가까운 단계로 옮겨 갑니다.
• 9월 이후 출시된 모델에 가격과 컨텍스트 길이가 생겼습니다. 내장 카탈로그가 09-06 시점에 머물러 GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Sol이 없었고, 이 모델들의 사용량은 가격이 계산되지 않았습니다. 이제 10-16 기준입니다. gpt-6.1-sol은 100만 토큰당 입력 2달러, 출력 10달러(캐시 적중 0.1달러), 컨텍스트 1,050,000입니다. 가격이 없던 기록에는 새로 가격이 붙고, 이미 계산된 기록은 그때의 요율을 유지합니다.
• 새 대화에서 추론 강도 슬라이더를 움직여도 되돌아가지 않습니다.
• 하위 에이전트의 추론 강도가 인터페이스 언어로 표시됩니다. 설정 → 하위 에이전트의 드롭다운이 어느 언어에서든 중국어 「关闭/低/中/高」로 나왔고, 버튼에는 「Default · 高」라고 적혀 있었습니다.

Nouveautés:

• L’app mobile a enfin sa propre mise en page. Jusqu’ici, c’était la fenêtre du bureau réduite à la taille du téléphone: une rangée de petits boutons en haut, cachés sous l’heure et la batterie, un cadre arrondi tracé autour de tout l’écran, le champ de saisie enfermé dans une deuxième carte, et des menus suspendus à côté de boutons de 44 pt. Désormais:.

• La barre du haut, sous la barre d’état, ne contient que trois éléments: la liste des discussions à gauche, le nom de la discussion au milieu, Nouvelle discussion à droite. Touchez le nom pour faire monter la feuille de la discussion: ses panneaux sur une rangée en haut (Fichiers, Contenu du fichier, Sous-agents, Discussion latérale, Tâches, Trace), puis Épingler, Renommer, Archiver et le reste.
• Tous les menus montent depuis le bas de l’écran et redescendent quand on les tire vers le bas ou qu’on touche la page assombrie. Les menus ouverts par un appui long restent à côté de la ligne ou du message que vous tenez.
• Le champ de saisie n’a plus que trois commandes: joindre, le modèle, envoyer. L’effort de raisonnement se choisit sur une rangée d’options dans la feuille du modèle, avec en dessous le mode d’autorisation et les modèles d’image et de vidéo. La puce du modèle dessine l’effort en barres et porte un point rouge tant que l’accès complet est activé.
• Les panneaux et les pages des réglages arrivent par la droite. Balayez depuis le bord gauche ou touchez ‹ pour revenir; sur la discussion elle-même, le même geste ouvre la liste des discussions. Sur Android, le bouton Retour ferme une chose à la fois — une feuille, une page, les réglages — au lieu de quitter l’app.
• Les réglages sont une liste sous un grand titre; chaque page s’ouvre par-dessus avec « ‹ Réglages », et les interrupteurs sont à côté de leur nom plutôt que sous leur description.
• Une nouvelle discussion présente ses quatre points de départ en deux rangées de cartes, au lieu d’une rangée défilante coupée au bord de l’écran.
• Ce qui ne sert à rien sur un téléphone n’y apparaît plus: les repères de questions le long du bord gauche, Ouvrir dans une nouvelle fenêtre, le plein écran et le bouton qui capturait l’écran du bureau.

Améliorations et corrections:

• Sur un iPhone réglé dans une autre langue que l’anglais, les écrans d’association étaient en anglais — et le titre de la page d’association était en chinois, quelle que soit la langue. L’app déclare maintenant à iOS les sept langues qu’elle parle: les écrans d’association, le sélecteur de photos derrière le + et le menu copier-coller suivent la langue du téléphone. La demande d’accès à la caméra dit à quoi elle sert — le code d’association ou une photo à envoyer — dans la langue du téléphone; c’était une seule phrase en chinois qui ne parlait que du code QR.
• Sur iPhone, un menu ouvert par un appui long se refermait dès qu’on levait le doigt. iOS envoie un clic de souris environ 130 ms après la fin d’un appui long, et ce clic tombait hors du menu. Le menu reste ouvert maintenant, et Copier copie.
• Sur iPhone, ouvrir une feuille ou la liste des discussions faisait passer l’heure et la batterie en noir sur la page assombrie, où on ne les lisait presque plus. iOS choisit leur couleur d’après ce qu’il y a dessous, et le voile translucide passait pour un fond clair. Elles restent lisibles maintenant.
• Une feuille avec un champ de recherche n’ouvre plus le clavier toute seule. Il cachait l’essentiel de la liste à parcourir.
• « Gérer les fournisseurs et les modèles » n’est plus proposé sur le téléphone. Les fournisseurs se configurent sur l’ordinateur, et sur le téléphone le lien ouvrait Général. Sans aucun modèle, la feuille du modèle indique maintenant où les ajouter.
• Réglages → Personnalisation a un titre en haut, comme toutes les autres pages.
• Les niveaux de raisonnement GPT suivent l’API d’OpenAI. GPT-6.1 Sol n’avait pas de niveaux à lui et retombait sur Désactivé/Faible/Moyen/Élevé. « Désactivé » envoyait effort: none, que ce modèle refuse; après l’erreur 400, Lyra n’envoyait plus aucun réglage de raisonnement, et le modèle réfléchissait donc au niveau Moyen par défaut — l’inverse de ce qui était demandé. Il va maintenant jusqu’à Très élevé et Maximum, et sur les modèles qui ne peuvent pas couper le raisonnement, « Désactivé » devient leur niveau le plus bas. Quelques anciennes entrées étaient fausses aussi: minimal sur GPT-5.6, et l’alias ultra de Codex envoyé tel quel. Un niveau qu’un modèle n’a pas passe au plus proche qu’il possède, au lieu de revenir à Moyen.
• Les modèles sortis depuis septembre ont un prix et une fenêtre de contexte. Le catalogue intégré datait du 06/09: ni GPT-6 Sol, ni GPT-6 Luna, ni GPT-6.1 Sol, dont l’usage n’était donc jamais chiffré. Il est maintenant au 16/10: gpt-6.1-sol coûte 2 $ en entrée et 10 $ en sortie par million de jetons (0,10 $ pour les accès au cache), avec un contexte de 1 050 000 jetons. L’usage enregistré sans prix en reçoit un; celui déjà chiffré garde son tarif.
• Le curseur de raisonnement d’une nouvelle discussion ne revient plus en arrière tout seul.
• Les niveaux de raisonnement des sous-agents s’affichent dans la langue de l’interface. Dans Réglages → Sous-agents, ils étaient en chinois quelle que soit la langue, et un bouton affichait « Default · 高 ».

Новое:

• У мобильного приложения появилась своя раскладка. Раньше это было окно десктопа, сжатое до размеров телефона: ряд мелких кнопок сверху уходил под часы и индикатор батареи, вокруг всего экрана была нарисована скруглённая рамка, поле ввода сидело ещё в одной карточке, а меню свисали рядом с кнопками размером 44 pt. Теперь:.

• В верхней панели под строкой состояния только три элемента: слева список бесед, посередине название беседы, справа «Новая беседа». Нажмите на название — снизу поднимется лист беседы: вверху ряд её панелей («Файлы», «Содержимое файла», «Субагенты», «Боковая беседа», «Задачи», «Трасса»), ниже «Закрепить», «Переименовать», «В архив» и остальное.
• Все меню поднимаются от нижнего края экрана и уходят обратно, если потянуть их вниз или коснуться затемнённой страницы. Меню по долгому нажатию, как и раньше, открываются рядом со строкой или сообщением, которое вы держите.
• В поле ввода три элемента: вложение, модель, отправка. Глубина рассуждений выбирается из ряда вариантов в листе модели, под ней — режим разрешений и модели изображений и видео. На плашке модели глубина нарисована столбиками, а пока включён полный доступ, на ней горит красная точка.
• Панели и страницы настроек въезжают справа. Чтобы вернуться, проведите от левого края или нажмите ‹; в самой беседе тот же жест открывает список бесед. На Android кнопка «Назад» закрывает по одному слою — лист, страницу, настройки — и больше не выходит из приложения сразу.
• Настройки — это список под крупным заголовком; каждая страница открывается поверх него с «‹ Настройки», а переключатели стоят рядом с названием, а не под описанием.
• Четыре варианта начала новой беседы теперь две строки карточек, а не горизонтальная лента, обрезанная у края экрана.
• Из телефонной версии убрано то, чем на телефоне не воспользоваться: отметки вопросов вдоль левого края, «Открыть в новом окне», полноэкранный режим и кнопка снимка экрана компьютера.

Улучшения и исправления:

• На iPhone с любым языком, кроме английского, экраны сопряжения были на английском — а заголовок страницы сопряжения был на китайском при любом языке. Теперь приложение сообщает iOS, какие семь языков оно знает, и экраны сопряжения, выбор фото за кнопкой + и меню «Скопировать/Вставить» следуют языку телефона. Запрос доступа к камере объясняет, зачем она нужна, — код сопряжения или фото для беседы — на языке телефона; раньше это была одна фраза на китайском только про QR-код.
• На iPhone меню по долгому нажатию закрывалось, как только вы отпускали палец. Примерно через 130 мс после долгого касания iOS присылает щелчок мыши, и он попадал мимо меню. Теперь меню остаётся открытым, а «Копировать» копирует.
• На iPhone при открытом листе или списке бесед часы и индикатор батареи становились чёрными на затемнённой странице и почти не читались. iOS выбирает их цвет по тому, что под ними, а полупрозрачное затемнение принималось за светлый фон. Теперь они остаются читаемыми.
• Лист с полем поиска больше не открывает клавиатуру сам. Она закрывала большую часть списка, по которому нужно было искать.
• На телефоне больше нет пункта «Управление поставщиками и моделями». Поставщиков настраивают на компьютере, а на телефоне ссылка открывала «Общие». Если моделей нет совсем, лист модели теперь говорит, где их добавить.
• У страницы «Настройки → Персонализация» появился заголовок, как у остальных.
• Уровни рассуждений GPT соответствуют API OpenAI. У GPT-6.1 Sol не было своих уровней, и она получала общий набор «Выкл./Низкая/Средняя/Высокая». «Выкл.» отправлял effort: none, который эта модель не принимает; после ошибки 400 Lyra переставала отправлять параметр рассуждений совсем, и модель думала на уровне «Средняя» по умолчанию — то есть ровно наоборот. Теперь доступны «Очень высокая» и «Максимум», а у моделей, где рассуждения нельзя отключить, «Выкл.» становится их самым низким уровнем. Исправлены и старые ошибки в таблице: minimal у GPT-5.6 и псевдоним ultra из интерфейса Codex, который уходил в запрос как есть. Уровень, которого у модели нет, переходит к ближайшему из её уровней, а не возвращается к «Средней».
• У моделей, вышедших после сентября, есть цены и размер контекста. Встроенный каталог оставался снимком от 06.09, без GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna и GPT-6.1 Sol, поэтому их расход не оценивался. Теперь он от 16.10: gpt-6.1-sol стоит $2 за ввод и $10 за вывод за миллион токенов ($0,10 за попадания в кэш), контекст — 1 050 000 токенов. Записи без цены получат её; уже оценённые сохранят свою ставку.
• Ползунок глубины рассуждений в новой беседе больше не отскакивает назад.
• Уровни рассуждений субагентов отображаются на языке интерфейса. В «Настройки → Субагенты» они были на китайском при любом языке, а на кнопке стояло «Default · 高».

apps.name: Waypage
apps.subtitle: Save a web page to your phone and read it with no connection: on a plane,
apps.localizedDescription:
Waypage:

Save a web page to your phone and read it with no connection: on a plane, in a tunnel, anywhere. Text is kept whole, images keep a small preview with a link to the full size, and videos keep a thumbnail that plays when you're back online. Every saved page links back to the original.

Plain HTML, CSS and JS with no build step and no dependencies. The same files run in a browser (GitHub Pages) and, wrapped by Capacitor, as the Android and iOS apps.

Status: saving and reading work: paste a link, read it offline. Sharing to the app from other apps is next (see TODO.md).

Run it:

node server.js (or double-click start.cmd on Windows) and open.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added:

• A device that set up GitHub sync before 1.29.1 shows "Make a safer token" at the top of Settings › GitHub sync: make a token for waypage-data only, paste it in, and delete the old one, without turning sync off.
• Settings › Saving › Load pictures only when tapped. Full-size and linked pictures come from their sites, which can see when you read a clip; with this on, a clip opened online loads nothing from the web until you tap a picture. Previews saved on the phone always show.

Installing: open this page on your phone, tap Waypage.apk, and allow your browser to install apps the first time it asks. Updates install over the top and keep your data.

iPhone: Waypage.ipa is added here a few minutes later. It's unsigned: install it with AltStore or SideStore, which sign it with your own Apple ID.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Waypage uses the camera to read the sync setup code from your other device.

apps.name: Mi Remote
apps.subtitle: Mi TV remote for macOS, Android and iOS: control Xiaomi TVs over Wi-Fi. MiLink protocol reverse engineered with REA
apps.localizedDescription:
Mi TV Remote:

Remote control apps for Xiaomi Mi TV (Android TV / PatchWall) on macOS, Android and iOS. They control the TV over Wi-Fi with no pairing and no ADB, using the TV's built-in MiLink remote service.

That service's protocol isn't documented, so it was reverse engineered with REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) from the TV's own firmware (see How it was reverse engineered).

The macOS app opened from the menu bar (left) and the TV screen, recorded at the same time over ADB (right). Watch the MP4.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Xiaomi. "Mi" and "Xiaomi" are trademarks of their respective owners.

Apps:

The iOS app (left: remote and TV picker) and the Android app (right), in the simulator and emulator, connected to a mock MiLink TV.

versions.localizedDescription:
First launch:

• macOS: the app is not notarized. Open it once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
• All platforms: allow Local Network access when asked; the app needs it to find and reach the TV.
• iPhone: apps sideloaded with a free Apple ID expire after 7 days; refresh them in AltStore/SideStore, or reinstall.

See the README for step-by-step instructions.

Changes:

• fix: commit the MiLink native module sources (c36d769).

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Mi Remote finds and controls your Mi TV on the local network.

apps.name: Ozen
apps.subtitle: Free, open-source live captions for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, on iPhone, iPad and Android. Runs on the phone, in Hebrew, English and 10 more languages
apps.localizedDescription:
Ozen (the word means "ear") turns what the people around you say into large, steady captions on your phone, as they speak. It was built for one grandmother with hearing loss, who found every existing transcription app either unreliable with external microphones or too shallow to trust.

• Captions that hold still. Words settle in place instead of jumping around, and a name shows who is talking.
• Private by design. No account and no company server: nothing leaves the phone unless you choose to send it.
• Alerts she won't miss. The doorbell, a smoke alarm or her own name makes the phone buzz, even in a pocket; alarms flash the whole screen.
• Talk back. Type a reply and the phone says it out loud, or shows it in huge letters.

versions.localizedDescription:
Ozen.ipa is the iPhone and iPad app: an unsigned device build for sideloading (Impactor, SideStore or AltStore re-sign it with your own Apple ID; it won't install any other way). Ozen.apk is the Android app, for Android 8 or later: open it on the phone and allow installing from that source when asked. Built from commit e68eb60dd9bc670ef76bfc077b855d651d570552; Settings shows 123 in brackets after the version on the iPhone, and 0.2.123 as the version on Android.

Changes since build 122:

• Android: the reuse test now starts from the shorter encoding.
• Android: drop a phone-test result that arrives as captions start, and say telemóvel in Portuguese.
• Android: reuse the speech encoding when a pass is retried at a higher temperature.
• Android: the phone test waits for captions to stop, and the model rating knows the phone's memory.
• iPhone: Test this phone ignores timing taken on another phone.
• Android: use the same wording as the iPhone for the phone check labels.
• Android: choose the speech model on the phone, and test how fast the phone is.
• iPhone: choose the speech model on first run, and test the phone.
• iPhone: big letters restore tests wait for the reply button to be tappable.
• iPhone: big letters UI tests pull the reply button on screen.
• iPhone: big letters UI tests wait for the reply button to be reachable.
• iPhone: Restore takes Clear's place so the big letters editor keeps its room.
• iPhone: restore-room test checks the composer opened.
• iPhone: restore-room test finds the typing field at any size.
• iPhone: test that Restore leaves the big letters editor room.
• iPhone: big letters Clear can be undone.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Ozen can send the microphone to your own computer at home, which captions faster than the phone.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ozen needs the microphone to caption conversation live.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Ozen uses Apple’s speech recognition to caption conversation live. It stays on the phone unless you turn on “Allow processing on Apple’s servers” in Ozen’s settings.

apps.name: Scanner REA
apps.subtitle: Independent on-device document scanner for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
Folha:

Independent, on-device document scanner for iPhone. Written in Swift with SwiftUI, VisionKit, Vision, Core Image and PDFKit. Requires iOS 17 or later.

Features: multi-page capture, photo import, perspective correction, image filters, rotation, local document library, OCR and searchable PDF export.

No account, subscription, advertising service or remote document upload is implemented. Scanned documents are stored locally on the device.

On macOS with Xcode and XcodeGen installed:

The GitHub Actions workflow builds artifacts/Folha-unsigned.ipa. It does not sign or install the app and does not use Apple account credentials. Signing and device installation are separate steps handled by the user.

The included tests are available for development but are not executed by the IPA-only workflow. Camera behavior and scan quality require device testing.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned iPhone IPA. External signing required. Independent implementation guided by REA evidence from historical CamScanner 5.26.12; not the original app or a claim of full equivalence.

Validated: 68/68 XCTest and UI tests passed, zero skipped; 128 recovered pixel cases with zero mismatches. CI: https://github.com/VaLycSay/folha-scanner-ios/actions/runs/38692460426

Includes library/import, single/batch capture, QR, recovered editor toolbar, perspective crop, rotation, filters, brightness/contrast/detail, text, ink/signature, opaque redactions, OCR and multipage PDF.

Camera hardware and installation on the user's iPhone remain unverified. Cloud sync, specialized ID/spreadsheet modes and full original-product parity are not included. Original IPA/binaries/assets are not distributed.

apps.name: Notes:
apps.subtitle: Apple Notes meets GitHub
apps.localizedDescription:
Notes::

Apple Notes meets GitHub. A native SwiftUI iPhone app (iOS 26 and newer; targets iOS 27 automatically once the build machine has the iOS 27 SDK) for local-first notes that can be linked to files in GitHub repositories, with real commits, history, diffs, offline editing and conflict resolution.

Status: the source was written without access to Xcode, so it has not yet been compiled or run on a device. The first CI run on a macOS runner is the first real build — see Status.

The bundle is always named nbwsc-vX.Y.Z.ipa (plus a .sha256). Two ways to get it:

• compute the next version from the latest vX.Y.Z tag (patch/minor/major, or type an explicit version) and refuse to reuse a tag,.
• run the unit tests,.
• archive the app and package an .ipa,.

nbwsc v1.1.1:

GitHub sign-in is not configured in this build (set the NOTES_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID repository variable). Local notes work regardless.

apps.name: Robo-Boy
apps.subtitle: A web application for controlling ROS 2 robots, tailored for mobile usage
apps.localizedDescription:
Robo-Boy:

Robo-Boy is a web, desktop, iPhone, and Android interface for controlling and visualizing ROS 2 robots. It includes camera streaming, configurable control pads, 3D visualization, native time-series plotting and signal analysis, behavior-tree editing, and custom themes. All interfaces run the same React codebase and connect to a separately installed ROS stack. The mobile packages are lightweight Tauri shells; the desktop can be built either as one of those or as an Electron shell, which is larger but brings its own Chromium and so has WebRTC wherever it runs.

Start With The App:

versions.localizedDescription:
iGhostVT 1.6.15 adds a drop zone to the relay, so a file moves between two devices with ighostvt-cli drop instead of being pasted through a terminal.

• The relay keeps a file for 30 minutes after the last device that put or got it disconnected, ighostvt-cli drop rm removes one sooner, and the relay forgets every file when it restarts. Drop zone files are not encrypted, unlike terminal sessions through the relay: keep secrets out of it. Update the relay's image to use it; RELAY_DROP_BYTES sets the space it may take (4 GiB by default) and 0 turns it off. The app itself has no drop zone controls, and devices on 1.6.14 keep working with this relay and with 1.6.15.

Choose iphoneos-arm64e for roothide, iphoneos-arm64 for a rootless bootstrap, iGhostVT-1.6.15-macos-notarized.zip for a Mac — it is signed and notarized, so it opens without clearing quarantine, and updates itself — or GhostRemote-1.6.15.ipa for an iPhone or iPad without custom firmware, which your sideloading app signs as it installs it. To run the relay, use the attached compose.yml; the image is ghcr.io/owngoal-dev/ighostvt-relay, and the digest is in relay-image.txt. SHA-256 sums are in SHA256SUMS, and the Mac app's in SHA256SUMS.macos.

apps.name: iCTRL
apps.subtitle: AI-friendly iOS automation service, built on XCUITest
apps.localizedDescription:
iCTRL:

AI-friendly iOS automation service, built on XCUITest.

For automated testing and research only. iCTRL hands full control of a phone (taps, text input, screen contents, every installed app) to whoever holds a paired key. Any automation like this can be hijacked or misused: a leaked key, a client you shouldn't have approved, or an agent acting on instructions it picked up along the way. Weigh the risks before you use it:

• Run it only on devices you own and accounts you are entitled to automate.
• Approve only the pairing requests you started.
• Leave remote access off unless you need it, and stop the server when you are done.
• Don't leave an agent unsupervised around payments, messages or anything that can't be undone.

versions.localizedDescription:
An AI-friendly iOS/iPadOS automation service. Tell your agent "My iPhone is running iCTRL at:8200 — figure out how to drive it." and it reads the on-device manual and takes it from there. Works with any agent that can make HTTP requests: OpenClaw, Hermes, Minis, Claude Code, Codex and others.

Which IPA do I need?:

Skip iCTRL.ipa if you mount the Developer Disk Image with Xcode or StikDebug, and manage the runner from its notification or a computer. With a free Apple ID you get three sideloaded apps, and SideStore uses one of them. Install StikDebug or the iCTRL app alongside the runner, not both.

Both IPAs are unsigned for distribution (ad-hoc, no provisioning profile). Sign them when you install:

• Paid account: Scripts/sign-ipa.sh -i iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa.

The runner also needs the Developer Disk Image mounted (Xcode, StikDebug or the iCTRL app). The README covers the whole setup.

Nearby discovery: no address to type:

• Reach the phone without an address. Turn on 📡 Nearby Discovery from the runner's notification or the iCTRL app (it needs Remote Access). Clients can then find the phone:.

• on the LAN, from any OS;
• from a Mac over Apple peer-to-peer Wi-Fi (AWDL), with no shared network at all. The phone only needs Wi-Fi switched on, not joined to anything.

• New client commands: python3 ictrl_rpc.py scan lists discovered phones, and --nearby "<name or id>" replaces --host. The first call pairs with the phone (approve once on the phone).
• Strict exposure:.

• Nothing is announced on the network unless nearby discovery is on.
• The AWDL listener accepts peer-to-peer connections only, and the main listener refuses them.
• Nearby discovery can be switched on only from the phone itself (notification, iCTRL app or USB).

• Advertising follows Wi-Fi off and on, and recovers if the interface is recreated.
• A failed listener is rebuilt.
• The notification says why nearby discovery isn't ready yet (turn on Wi-Fi, allow Local Network).

Who can reach the phone, at a glance:

• The status notification's first line shows one of: 🔒 This device only, 🌐 LAN reachable, or 📡 Nearby discoverable.
• The iCTRL app has a Visibility menu: 🟢 This device only · safe / 🟡 LAN / 🟡 LAN + nearby.
• LAN addresses are real interfaces only. VPN or proxy tunnel addresses such as 198.18.0.1 are no longer shown as the phone's address.

Pairing and keys:

• Every pairing is approved on the phone. The "trusted for 10 minutes" shortcut is gone.
• Limits on requests:.

• An unanswered request is refused after 60 s.
• Only one request waits at a time, with a 15 s cooldown after a refusal.
• Requests from the phone itself have their own slot, so a remote caller can't lock them out.

• Check the key. The prompt shows a key fingerprint that the client also prints; allow only if they match.
• One key per device. Clients store keys per device, so a phone paired once works over USB, the LAN and nearby without pairing again. Keys stored under an address by older clients are picked up automatically.
• Local Network permission. The runner asks for it at launch and reports it. The iCTRL app warns when it's missing; without it, nearby discovery can't work even though LAN clients may still connect.

iCTRL app:

• Authorized Clients: every key holder, where each last connected from (this device / USB, LAN, nearby, VPN), revoke one or all others.
• Runner Logs: the runner's log, live, with pause, refresh and filter.
• Visibility menu (above), and a warning when the runner lacks Local Network access.

Clients:

• Python client:.

• Standard library only. LAN pairing no longer needs pip install cryptography.
• Never sends iCTRL requests through an http_proxy.
• If macOS Local Network privacy refuses the process, it relays nearby connections through the system nc.

• C CLI: gets the same nearby support when built on macOS. The Linux static binary is rebuilt.

Server and API:

• GET /whoami and an X-ICTRL-Device header on every response identify the device.
• config adds nearby_discovery and device_name, and reports nearby status and LAN addresses. Each client's last address and source appear in its session entry.
• config now validates every parameter before changing any.
• A change that restarts the listener replies first instead of returning an empty response.
• Read-only polling (logs, plain config) no longer fills the log.

Known limitations:

• Nearby discovery over AWDL needs macOS on the client side. A phone whose screen is off may stop being discoverable over AWDL, as with AirDrop.
• With nearby discovery on, iOS also announces the phone's own host name on the LAN, which often contains its owner's name.
• Endpoints that need no key (/schema, /skill, /remote, /whoami, /pair) also answer over AWDL, and the screen stream is not encrypted on any channel.

Full details:.

apps.name: OpenAgentd
apps.subtitle: Open-source desktop app for a local coding agent. Watch every tool call, diff, and terminal command. Bring your own models; sessions stay on your machine
apps.localizedDescription:
OpenAgentd:

Get started ·.

Facebook Group ·.

Contribute.

Why OpenAgentd:

Most coding agents live in a terminal or an editor. OpenAgentd is a coding-first native desktop app and mobile companion where you can run an agent, follow work in real time, inspect what changed, and keep moving without losing context.

• See the work. Streamed replies, tool calls, arguments, results, timings, files, diffs, terminal output, and agent status are visible in one interface.
• Track tasks. A clean, user-readable taskboard checklist keeps current work and progress visible at a glance.
• Work in real repositories. Coding sessions open local folders, support isolated git worktrees, show changes and history, and return language-server diagnostics after edits.

versions.localizedDescription:
Breaking Changes:

• Project skills, commands and snippets are now read only from .agents/. Move anything in a project's .openagentd/skills, .openagentd/commands or .openagentd/snippets (or .opencode/) into the same subfolder of .agents/, and anything in ~/.config/opencode/skills into ~/.agents/skills. .openagentd/ still holds local runtime state.

• When Claude declines to continue, you now see an error card with Anthropic's explanation and options to retry or switch models. The turn no longer ends silently, and the refused reply is dropped from context, so asking the agent to continue is no longer refused again.
• Stop always works: a turn that doesn't respond to Stop is force-ended, and the session goes back to idle within about 10 seconds.

• A mode you pick while a plan review or question is open now applies to the next message you send.
• Desktop Reload reopens the session the window was on, instead of the latest session in the last workspace.
• A JS plugin stuck in a busy loop is interrupted after 5 seconds instead of hanging the server. Plugin hooks time out after 60 seconds.
• MCP tool calls that never get an answer now fail after 210 seconds instead of waiting forever. Each server can set its own timeout (1–270 s) under Tool timeout in Settings, or with timeout in mcp.json.
• Drafts in the composer, in answers to agent questions and in plan-review comments now survive a reload.
• Quick Open and the @ picker now find gitignored workspace files, such as rendered videos or build output. They appear below other matches, and node_modules, .env files and very large ignored folders are left out. A workspace opened at a repository subfolder now applies every parent .gitignore.
• Workspace videos play right in the panel; use the player's own fullscreen button for full screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
ReFlo+ 1.0.6:

A free, touch-first controller for the Behringer Flow 8, built for working live techs. Fader strips for every mix, a drag-to-edit parametric EQ, graphic EQ, FX control, output limiter and delay, sends matrix, scenes, and mute groups.

Free to download and use. No account, no ads, no tracking. It works fully offline: the only network request is an optional check on the first screen for a newer version.

What's new in 1.0.6.

• Mac app: a double-click ReFlo+ for macOS 12 or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel). It opens the full app in your web browser. See Install below for the one-time "Open Anyway" step.
• Update notice: the first screen now checks this page for a newer version and shows a note with a link if there is one. It does nothing when you're offline. On Android this adds an Internet permission, used only for that check.
• No Windows version: I tried. A Windows PC connects and sends commands fine, but Windows never delivers the mixer's replies, so the app can't load the mixer. It works on Mac, Android and iPhone/iPad.
• Nothing else changed from 1.0.5.

Still to confirm from 1.0.5 (please tell me if you see problems): the black screen after connecting should be fixed, but I can't test every device, and the Troubleshooting notes on the first screen help me find out why if it returns. The output EQ frequency and Q writes and the Main balance write aren't yet confirmed on a real mixer, so check them against the mixer's display.

What's new in 1.0.5.

• Output EQ, two modes: every output (Main, Mon 1, Mon 2) has a GEQ mode (nine fixed octave bands: drag up and down, paint across bands) and a Parametric mode (each of the nine nodes has its own frequency, gain and Q). Lock frequencies, Reset and Flat are there too.
• Channel EQ: the lowest band is a bell with a Q control, like the others.
• Main output Balance slider.
• Full-screen EQ: an amber Expand button opens any channel or output EQ full screen. Close returns you; on Android the Back button closes it first.
• FX tap tempo: the TAP button flashes on every beat.
• Gain reduction: a light overlay on the level meter with a solid edge.
• Disconnect from mixer and Leave demo return to the start screen.

Earlier: 1.0.4 added the Troubleshooting notes. 1.0.3 added phone layouts, a Display size slider, full-height faders and a loading message. 1.0.2 added demo mode, optional tap animation and button haptics (off by default).

Install:

Android.

• Open it. Allow "install unknown apps" for your browser or file app when asked.
• If Play Protect warns about an unknown developer, choose Install anyway.
• Open ReFlo+, press Pairing on the Flow 8, then tap Connect to Mixer. Allow the Bluetooth / Nearby devices permission.

iPhone / iPad The IPA is unsigned. Install it with your usual sideloading tool (for example AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly or TrollStore), which signs it for your device. Then pair as above and allow Bluetooth access.

Mac.

• Unzip reflo-plus-mac.zip and open ReFlo+ (move it to Applications if you like).
• macOS will say it can't verify the app, because it isn't notarized by Apple. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway (on older macOS, right-click the app and choose Open).
• Allow Bluetooth when asked. ReFlo+ opens in your web browser; keep its small window open while you work and click Quit when finished.
• Press Pairing on the Flow 8, then click Connect to Mixer.

Good to know:

• The Flow 8 accepts one control connection at a time. Close the official FLOW Mix app before connecting ReFlo+.
• It sends live commands to the mixer (levels, phantom power, routing). Check settings before a show.
• The mixer controls (faders, sends, mutes, solos, gain, comp, EQ, 48V, graphic EQ, output delay, scenes, mute groups) were tested on a real Flow 8. Still being confirmed on hardware: the FX presets and tempo, the Setup toggles, channel renaming by press-and-hold, and the iPhone/iPad app itself. Please report anything odd.
• FX preset names are ReFlo+'s own and may not match the official app. The effects themselves are the mixer's.
• Gain-reduction display is a rough guide (four steps), not a dB reading.

Legal:

Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Behringer or Music Tribe. "Behringer" and "Flow 8" are trademarks of their owners, used only to say which mixer this works with. Free to use, closed source, under the freeware licence below. Provided as is, with no warranty. Use at your own risk. Please don't sell or repackage it.

by Michael Wright.

Masterpiece plays sampled pipe organs. It reads Hauptwerk-format sample sets and GrandOrgue organs, draws each instrument's own console, and plays it from the mouse, a MIDI keyboard or a full console. It is an independent implementation in C++20 and JUCE, licensed GPL-3.0-only.

• Standalone application, VST3 and LV2 plugins, and an Audio Unit on macOS.

versions.localizedDescription:
Masterpiece 0.8.0 is the culmination of a series of performance and usability efforts, including 48% lower processor use and 99% fewer late audio blocks under heavy playing, 36% faster listing of split RAR sets, composite definition support, a split mode for single-manual setups, automatic portrait and landscape layouts, and several fundamental sample reproduction enhancements, from natural swell boxes to release-preserving voice allocation.

New features:

• Composite organs: you can now open premade composite definitions, organs assembled from the pipework of several sample sets, such as Augustine's Jehmlich and Zamardi-Buda composites. Masterpiece finds the sets they play in the composite's folder and the folders in it, in your package folder and in your sample libraries, and reads them straight from their archives. Point it once to a set you keep elsewhere, and it remembers. The Jehmlich composite plays 11,785 samples from five archives and opens again in 5.3 s (#289, #376).
• Package folder: choose where you keep your sample sets in Organ settings > Loading > Package folder, and every composite looks there (#376).
• Standard component noises: composites that use the standard components package play key action, stop action and blower noises made by Masterpiece (#378).
• Split keyboard: one keyboard plays the whole organ. Up to three split points divide it into zones, each sending its keys to a manual or the pedal, with a second manual layered and its own octave and transposition. The lowest key you hold can play the pedal. Nine presets are shared by every organ, three of them ready made; each organ keeps its own layout, and every control can be learned from MIDI. Open it from View > Split keyboard (#358, #364).
• Flatpak for Linux: one bundle for every x86-64 distribution, installed with flatpak install and run in its sandbox (#237, #370).
• Automatic portrait layout: a window or screen taller than it is wide shows the organ's portrait layout, and a wider one its main layout. A layout you choose yourself holds until the window turns, and the toolbar names the portrait layout (#366, #368).
• Steady MIDI learning: in Settings > MIDI, learning can take a key once it has been held a quarter second, so only the key you mean is learned (#365).
• Saved starting state: the stops drawn become the organ's starting state, kept with the organ (#317).
• Sequencer number keys: the keys 1 to 9 go to that frame, and 0 to the tenth (#316).

Improvements:

• Faster split RAR sets: volumes are listed in parallel, two volumes in 0.9 s, down from 1.4 s (-36%) on an NVMe drive, and a sample that spans two volumes is read whole (#321, #361).

• Complete definition packages: a definition published as a package of its own, such as Hill, Burton-Berlin's, opens together with the sample packages beside it (#345, #371).

• Marked unavailable stops: drawn as the set draws them, and named as not available when the mouse is over them (#304, #369).
• Tidier panels: a control drawn in several places appears once, under the organ's own name, and an organ that draws its pistons lists them (#314, #374).

Bug fixes:

• Hill, Burton-Berlin Unison Off: Unison Off now silences the manual's own division, and its octave couplers keep sounding (#345, #372).
• Melody and bass couplers: a chord now couples its top note, or its bottom note for a bass coupler, as one note (#355, #373).
• St. Mary, Portsea General Cancel and generals: General Cancel now clears all 38 stops, and the generals store them (#366, #367).
• Upper Norwood swell shoes: either shoe now moves the swell, and both pictures follow (#366, #375).
• Nowa Ruda jambs: every playing stop now shows at full brightness (#304, #369).
• Portrait jambs: each stop shows the picture of the layout on screen (#308, #363).
• Toggling MIDI buttons: a stop's button now draws it on the first press after a cancel, and General Cancel or a piston on a toggling button fires on every press (#366, #379).
• Generals in older MIDI maps: generals mapped on an organ before the console kept its own map now come back with that organ, and their buttons recall them (#366, #381).
• Natural swell boxes: a closed box now lowers the level by the set's overall figure and rolls off the treble to the depth the set states, so the Augustine sets keep 9 dB more of their bass when closed (#366, #382).
• Accented names on Windows: archives and folders named with letters such as "ö" now open and play (#377).

Thanks to ahall41, ppytprs, puciak, vpoguru, michaelbacayo and klangpost for the reports behind these.
